title: After Marriage, the Dumped Tycoon Grips Her Waist and Begs to Reconcile
author: Qiuqiu Kenanjun
synopsis:
[Torment-and-redemption romance, possessive top-tier wealthy family] Ning Qing was once a woman of the pleasure quarters, working at a private club, until by chance she became the little woman in Li Ren's villa. 

They had been together for a year, and Li Ren tormented her in every way, but one day, because of a single sentence from Ning Qing, he suddenly changed. He could drag her down to hell, and he could also spoil her to the heavens. A year later, Ning Qing discovered that she was nothing more than a pet he kept. His control and possessiveness left her unable to breathe.

 His identity was shrouded in mystery and his methods were ruthless and murderous, and Ning Qing, having seen them, was determined to escape. He let out a scornful laugh: "A fox raised at home can't run away." Ning Qing...

chapters.title: Today, We Play with Just Her
chapters.content:
The most exclusive gilded club in Jiang'an City, Country A, was the height of earthly luxury, enough to make one feel as though they had stepped into a palace.

In the magnificent dressing room, Ning Qing finished applying her bold, seductive makeup without any expression on her face and put on a low-cut, sexy white hip-hugging dress.

"Time to work! Hurry up, girls! Let's go!"

Madam Lily came to call them, as carefree as ever.

A trace of allure was rubbed onto Ning Qing's delicate, dewy face.

It was almost eight. Time to start work.

She hated this job, but the money was too good to refuse.

Hearing the call, a crowd of beautiful women of every type adjusted their poses, and in their revealing outfits lined up neatly in a row, arranging their expressions in unison, ready to go and receive the guests.

"Today we have a big client. The eldest daughter of the Lin Corporation is here! Everyone, loosen up and play along, understand? If Miss Lin is happy, there's no limit to the money!"

The Madam's words set off a flurry of excited whispers, each of them hoping to be chosen.

Ning Qing, however, knit her brows, and a flicker of unease crossed her eyes.

The Lin family? The Ning family had once had dealings with them. On the surface they ran a chain of luxury hotels, but they had built their fortune on shady business, had murky ties to gangs, and had a terrible reputation in the business world.

Why would an eldest daughter of such a family come to a place like this?

As she thought, her feet had already carried her to the door of the private room.

Inside the oversized party room, a dozen or so women stood in a row like goods on a shelf, waiting to be picked over.

On the sofa opposite sat ten men and one woman.

"Miss Lin, your visit is truly an honor for us! Take a look and see, and if you like any type, just tell me, Lily. There are plenty more~"

Madam Lily greeted them warmly.

On the sofa, a tall, fair-skinned woman stood up.

Ning Qing glanced at her. Her long hair was silky, and she was decked out in gorgeous, extravagant jewelry and an expensive gown, every piece of a rich girl's luxury outfit in place.

She had met her a few times years ago, and she was still the same, her attitude as arrogant as ever, a sharp little mouth wearing an unreadable smile.

Ning Qing gave a cold laugh inside. This Miss Lin probably meant no good. Never mind, at worst she would just be mocked and jeered at for a while.

Lin Yamei made a show of strutting on her sky-high heels in front of the women for a lap, then stopped in front of Ning Qing.

She pointed one finger at her.

"Her!"

The Madam said, fawning, "Miss Lin certainly has an eye! Ning Qing is our top girl here! What about the other gentlemen, would they like to pick someone as well?"

"No need. Today, we play with just her!"

Lin Yamei tilted her head slightly, a knowing smile on her lips.

Ning Qing sucked in a cold breath, and an ominous premonition came over her.

The Madam cared only about how much money there was, and as for how many people it would be, she couldn't have cared less.

"Just one?"

"Mm!"

"Miss Lin, if it's only one, then the price..."

The Madam asked cautiously with a smile in her eyes, her hand making the gesture for money.

Lin Yamei glanced over and gave a slight nod, signaling one of her underlings to hand over a bag.

"Would I shortchange you? This is enough, isn't it?"

The Madam glanced at the bag stuffed with cash and instantly broke into a satisfied smile, giving Ning Qing a look that said to serve well.

"Take good care of Miss Lin... Miss Lin, please feel free to play as you like!"

The door closed, leaving the private room in silence.

Ning Qing's throat bobbed, and she thought to herself:

I have to be careful this time. With this much money paid, I should just see her off properly.

A sly look flashed across Lin Yamei's face, her eyes fixed on Ning Qing, the corner of her mouth curving in a sneer.

"I never thought that after a few years apart, Miss Ning would be doing this? Tsk... We're old acquaintances, so there's no need to put on airs!"

Her tone was full of provocation.

The several men on the sofa looked at Ning Qing with lecherous eyes, roving over her body without pause.

Ning Qing felt no fear at all. In these three years, plenty of people had sneered at and mocked her. Currying favor with the high and trampling the low was the norm, especially toward a once-lofty daughter of the Ning family like her.

Once she had fallen, everyone had piled on as the wall collapsed.

She had seen this sort of scene many times.

"Miss Lin, it's been a while! Thank you for your patronage. How would you like to play?"

Lin Yamei pursed her lips and, not bothering with more words, picked up a glass of wine from the table and walked over to Ning Qing.

"You're a hostess, so naturally you should drink. Today, keep my boys company and drink to your heart's content. Don't say I don't look after your business."

Ning Qing gave a cold laugh inside, helpless. She took the glass calmly and composedly, not a trace of panic on her delicate face, a calm smile appearing at the corner of her lips.

"All right, Miss Lin, I'll drink it!"

As she spoke, Ning Qing lifted her swan-like neck and drained it in one go, every movement still supremely elegant.

"Miss Lin, are you satisfied?"

Lin Yamei sat on the table, crossing her legs, and let out a snort of laughter, not yet done.

"This is nothing! I have a dozen brothers here, and you'll have to toast each of them in turn!"

Drink? Fine!

The drinks counted toward her sales anyway, so why not take them.

Ning Qing nodded and said with a smile, "All right, as long as Miss Lin is happy, I'll toast them one by one!"

With that, she picked up the bottle and glass and walked up to the men who were all staring at her with ill intent, an impeccable smile on her face, and poured drinks for each of them in turn.

The men's eyes were full of mockery and smugness. To think that they would one day have this lofty young lady pouring drinks for them.

Two of them even kept sneaking touches at her fair, tender little hands.

Ning Qing deftly avoided their deliberate contact, and her soft, subtle movements only seemed to make the men more restless and unable to sit still, so that they were nearly drooling.

Lin Yamei watched quietly, thoroughly pleased with herself, and said to Du Ziming, who was craning his neck beside her:

"See that? That's the former eldest daughter of the Ning financial group, Ning Qing. I only learned a few days ago that she had sunk to being a hostess. Back when the Ning family was at its peak, our Lin family even wanted to work with them. Who would have thought this young lady of the Ning family would end up like this!"

Of course Ning Qing knew these words were meant for her ears.

Three years ago, the Ning family had been burned in a fire. More than a dozen people were buried in the sea of flames, the family business was carved up entirely by the elders, and all that remained was her mother, a vegetative patient living in an expensive ICU ward.

If she hadn't been driven into a corner, she would never have fallen this low.

Besides caring for her mother, the only thing she had left to do in the rest of her life was to find the one who set the fire and take revenge.

To take revenge, even if she had to sink into the dust, she would not hesitate.

Du Ziming hooked an arm around Lin Yamei's shoulder and whispered lecherously:

"Really? This is the Ning family's young lady? I've only ever seen her on TV reports. No wonder she has such a bearing. She's even prettier than on TV..."

Lin Yamei snorted disdainfully.

"Working in a lowly place like this, who knows how many old men's beds she's climbed into already. And she's still a 'young lady'!"

Du Ziming stroked his chin, looking Ning Qing over with a leering face.

"If she were sold to Qianhua Club, she'd surely fetch a lot of money!"

Lin Yamei said with a wicked smile and a look of smug pride:

"What's the hurry? I have something even more thrilling..."

She hadn't come today only to mock her.

Ning Qing faintly overheard these half-veiled words and had only smiled thinly, pretending not to know, until she heard those three words, and her heart lurched.

Qianhua Club? That was the filthiest place in the entire city.

If that was what they had in mind, she could absolutely not sit and wait for her fate!

Gritting her teeth, she put down her glass and walked up to Lin Yamei, softening her tone:

"Miss Lin, if you came today to make me apologize, then I'm sorry! It's only that I don't quite understand. Miss Lin and I have no quarrel. Surely you don't have to leave me with no way out?"

Lin Yamei curled her lip haughtily, her eyes full of disdain, and said with a light laugh:

"I never thought Miss Ning would be so quick to read the room! If you had known, why do this in the first place? Now you know to apologize? Too bad! It's too late!"

"If Miss Lin finds me displeasing, this time I am willing to take it as my apology for... Ah!"

Before she could finish, a glass of ice-cold red wine mixed with ice cubes was poured down over Ning Qing's head.

Lin Yamei swirled her empty glass, her face full of scorn.

Raucous laughter burst out all around.

Ning Qing raised a hand to wipe the wine from her chin, and the cold in her eyes only deepened.

"What are you doing? Do I have some great feud with you?"

"Oh dear! What are you saying? My hand just slipped! Tsk tsk tsk! You look so pitiful, it almost moves me! Hahaha! How do you feel, Miss Ning? Have you had enough to drink today?"

Neither Lin Yamei nor Ning Qing knew at that moment that this humiliation of Ning Qing would bring an unexpected person into it, one who would make Lin Yamei regret it until her guts turned green...

chapters.title: Sir! Please Help Me!
chapters.content:
They mocked and sneered without restraint.

The air was thick with the mingled smell of smoke and alcohol, and noisy laughter and jeering rang endlessly in her ears.

Ning Qing stood quietly where she was, silent, but the indifference in her eyes only deepened. Holding her breath and steadying her mind, she watched coldly the din and ugliness in the private room.

As she thought, Ning Qing steadied herself, and without the screams and rage Lin Yamei had hoped for, she smiled politely and said:

"I really don't know how I have offended you. If Miss Lin is unhappy and simply wants to vent, I have nothing to say."

"Stop playing dumb with me! The Ning family was arrogant, and you're no better! Today I'm going to make you taste what it is to be beneath others!"

---

The Corridor Outside the Private Room

A tall man leaned lazily against the wall, elegantly lighting a cigarette.

Two men stood respectfully beside him, and one of them said:

"Sir, the family head told us to bring the young son-in-law home. Couldn't I simply use the Li family's name and have the owner here hand him over, instead of searching one room at a time? There are forty or fifty private rooms in this place."

The other seemed to understand the man's intention and said calmly:

"Sir probably doesn't want anyone to know he came here. Making a fuss would only make things worse."

The man glanced at him, as if tacitly agreeing, and gave a light laugh:

"Go and look. Lin Munan's people are surely standing at the door, so it should be easy to recognize him."

"Yes, sir!"

The two bowed and left, and the man smoked in silence, the smoke curling languidly around him.

He looked like it was none of his business, toying with a string of prayer beads in his hand, his eyes thoughtful.

---

Inside the private room, Ning Qing's eyes showed contempt.

"Miss Lin?"

Lin Yamei's expression suddenly went cold, her sly little face carrying a vicious edge.

"Cut it out! I can't stand that arrogant look of yours! You always stole my spotlight back then and looked down on the Lin Corporation's cooperation proposals! Now you've fallen this low and you're still putting on airs! Do I need to remind you? You're no longer the eldest daughter of the Ning financial group! Do you expect those few burned to ash to climb out and back you up?"

Hearing of that year, a mist rose in Ning Qing's eyes, and her gaze grew colder still.

It was one thing to gloat, but to use the thing that hurt her most to mock her!

Anger mixed on Ning Qing's face. She wiped the wine off her face. Even if she were beaten today, she would never allow anyone to slander the Ning family!

She couldn't help a cold snort and said:

"Miss Lin, heaven's justice comes around. Who knows, maybe one day the Lin Corporation will suffer a disaster that wipes it out too?"

Lin Yamei's face went from red to green to white. She had not expected Ning Qing to dare talk back, and said, eyes wide:

"You little slut..."

Then she stepped forward and slapped her hard.

Ning Qing's cheek showed a handprint. Before she could hit back, Lin Yamei looked at Du Ziming, signaling him to act.

Du Ziming stuck out his tongue, took a small bottle from his pocket, and with a lecherous face poured some unknown liquid into a glass of wine.

Ning Qing's pupils contracted. Given the Lin family's ways, she didn't need to think to know what it was.

How dare she be so lawless!

"I warn you to think it through! If you dare do anything to me, I will never let it go!"

Ning Qing's warning was stern, a sharp light flashing in her eyes as she glared fearlessly at Du Ziming and the group of men, awing everyone present for a moment.

Du Ziming, hesitating a little, whispered to Lin Yamei:

"Miss, the Ning family used to be giants in the traditional medicine trade. Her uncle and aunt are all still there..."

Lin Yamei's eyes turned, and she glared fiercely at Du Ziming.

"What's to be afraid of! The Ning family's assets were seized long ago by her estranged second uncle. There is no way he'd look after an orphan like her!"

Impatient, Lin Yamei snatched the glass, meaning to do it herself.

"Give it to me! Whatever happens, I'll take responsibility!"

Du Ziming came to his senses, stepped forward, and wrapped an arm around Ning Qing, leaving her unable to move.

"Behave!"

"Miss Lin, you dare..."

"Whether I dare or not, just try and see!"

Lin Yamei gripped Ning Qing's jaw hard, her face twisted, and began to force the drink into her.

Ning Qing's cheeks ached from the pinching, and her throat was forced to swallow the strong liquor, making her cough and choke, her body twisting involuntarily as she tried to break free. In the struggle she finally touched a dart taped to her thigh and drove it hard into Du Ziming's wrist.

"Ah!"

With a shocked cry of pain, Ning Qing seized the moment, turned, and ran out the door.

Lin Yamei's glass fell as well. She stood stunned for a moment before shouting at the others:

"What are you standing there for? Go after her, quickly!"

Ning Qing fled in a panic. She knew that in her current state, the most urgent thing was to find somewhere to hide!

Running and looking back as she went, she saw the fitting room close at hand.

Suddenly her foot slipped, and she fell.

Her knees slammed against the hard cold floor, and the sharp pain left her momentarily dazed, her face turning white as paper.

No... my revenge is not yet done! How can I fall into the hands of someone like Lin Yamei!

The footsteps drew nearer, and just as she was enduring the pain and hurriedly trying to get up, a pair of heavy leather boots suddenly came into view.

Ning Qing lifted her head sharply, and a tall, sharp-featured man stood before her.

Wasn't this the man she had glimpsed in the corridor earlier, judging by his clothes?

He looked about six feet three, broad and powerful, his straight, long legs planted firmly, a lock of hair falling carelessly across his brow, and a pair of ink-black eyes studying her with a trace of puzzlement.

What a handsome man.

That was her first impression.

What was she doing! She was running for her life!

Ning Qing, as if she had seen a lifeline, endured the sharp pain and begged the man:

"Sir! Please help me! Someone is chasing me!"

The man did not move, a slight crease between his brows as if a little impatient.

Seeing that he ignored her, Ning Qing hurriedly tried to get up, but the pain in her leg left her unable to run anymore.

Hiss...

It hurt so much! Ning Qing clung to the wall, her knee bruised purple from the fall, unable to take a single step, beads of sweat rising on her forehead from the pain.

The man looked her over, glanced at his watch, then swept his eyes around the area.

Several urgent footsteps drew close behind them, about to reach the corner.

The next second, he let out a light sigh.

What a bother!

He reached out, pulled her up, turned, and guided her into an empty stall in the fitting room ahead.

The space was cramped and narrow. Ning Qing instinctively covered her mouth, even her breathing careful, afraid of making the slightest sound.

Outside, a few men's voices sounded somewhat puzzled:

"Where did that damn girl run off to? In this little space, could she have flown away?"

"Impossible! She must be hiding somewhere! You go look over there, I'll check here again! She drank our medicine, she can't get away! The drug should be about to take effect, so listen carefully!"

"Yes!"

In the fitting room stall a few meters away, the man listened warily to the sounds outside and asked softly:

"Who is chasing you?"

His voice was magnetic and gentle, with a trace of coldness that was hard to detect.

Ning Qing shook her head in terror and pressed a slender finger lightly against her lips, signaling him to keep quiet.

After a while, as the footsteps faded, the man was about to go out, but Ning Qing, eyes wide, hurriedly grabbed his forearm and warned him in a whisper as thin as a mosquito's whine:

"Don't move! The people looking for me are from a gang! If you're spotted, you'll die too! Wait a little longer!"

chapters.title: Pretty, but Not Fun to Play With
chapters.content:
A moment later, she closed her eyes in shame and anger. As the man's aggressive invasion was accompanied by a chilling kiss, a sudden tearing pain rippled through her body.

Ning Qing snapped her eyes open, her brows furrowed in agony. Her eyes were as clear and pristine as a tranquil lake, now shrouded in a thin layer of mist.

"Ah!"

Ning Qing let out a soft cry. Seeing the face that was so close it was practically touching hers, she pulled her shoulders inward with a trace of helplessness.

Watching her flustered and pained expression, the man found it amusing. The corners of his lips curved upward as he said:

"No need to thank me."

"..."

Under the dim lighting, her skin glistened with a fine layer of sweat.

Having never been touched like this before, even the gentlest movements caused her to tremble uncontrollably.

After an unknown length of time, the bone-deep agony in Ning Qing's body subsided somewhat amidst her muffled, uncontrollable whimpers and shivers.

"No wonder she's so sensitive. She really is a virgin."

The man slowly halted his movements, a teasing note in his voice. When he raised his eyes, his gaze held a trace of tenderness.

Ning Qing's intoxicated eyes carried a hint of resentment. She lightly bit her lower lip as her brows furrowed.

If she hadn't been drugged, she would have crippled this man's hands right now! Damn Lin Yamei! I will definitely make you pay the price for this!

Their gazes locked, his scorching stare seemingly capable of piercing straight through her.

Ning Qing stubbornly averted her face. Her breathing was already falling short, forcing her to pant softly through slightly parted lips.

The man spoke in a somewhat dissatisfied tone:

"What? You're not going to show any gratitude after I helped you? Still better than being passed around by a bunch of men, wouldn't you say?"

"I-I didn't ask for your help..."

The man let out a light scoff, his well-defined jaw resting softly against her ear as he murmured:

"Your body was a lot more honest than your mouth."

Though they hadn't directly consummated things, this method of relief made Ning Qing feel even more ashamed and disgraced. Her flushed face burned with a helpless confusion.

She never imagined that her first time... would be lost in a manner like this!

"You... you are taking advantage of a person's vulnerability!"

"Oh? Shouldn't this be considered 'drawing my sword to help a person in distress upon seeing an injustice'?"

It was rare for him to do a 'good deed', and yet he was being spurned? Truly ungrateful.

The man pressed his lips together slightly, a flash of untamed defiance in his eyes. He slowly raised his hand, the tips of his two slender fingers stained with a vivid streak of crimson. Looking down at the woman in his arms who had just begun to calm down, a teasing smile hung on his face.

Ning Qing's eyes were slightly red-rimmed. She glanced at him, then hastily looked away.

"Who... who are you?"

He had seen plenty of beauties, but he had never felt this kind of urge to possess someone.

That unique fragrance and touch drew him in like magic, making him involuntarily intoxicated by it.

"I came here to look for someone. Helping you just now wasted quite a bit of my time."

A trace of confusion flickered across Ning Qing's hazy eyes. Her head felt heavy and dizzy, and she clutched her temples in mild distress.

"My head... it's spinning."

Li Ren curled his lip, stepped out of the cramped cubicle, straightened his clothes, casually pulled out a tissue to vigorously wipe his fingers a few times, and then tossed it away.

Pretty, but not fun to play with!

What a pity. He still had matters to attend to at the moment, otherwise he wouldn't mind breaking her in properly.

Li Ren glanced coldly at Ning Qing, whose consciousness was rapidly fading. After a moment of hesitation, he easily scooped her up out of the cubicle.

"W-what are you doing?"

"Finding you a place to rest. If someone else sees you looking like this, you won't be able to keep your virtue either way."

Ha! As if what you did to me counts as keeping my virtue!

Ning Qing rolled her eyes in annoyance, already too weak to argue.

As if seeing right through her thoughts, the man let out a light scoff and added:

"Rest assured, I don't force people against their will."

Just as the two of them stepped out into the hallway, they ran into a few members of the Xinglong Gang running around like headless chickens, still searching everywhere.

Seeing a man carrying her, Du Ziming sneered and said:

"I told you, where else could she run after taking my family's drug? Well, here she is! Hey you, are you a security guard? Put that woman down! Don't mess up Xinglong Gang business!"

In the distance, two identically dressed men walked rapidly toward Li Ren.

These two were named Jin Shui and Yin Shui respectively. They bowed respectfully to him and said:

"Sir, we have found the private room where the young master-in-law is located!"

"Hmm."

Du Ziming was completely baffled, his gaze shifting back and forth between Li Ren and the two attendants.

An orphan girl, what kind of big shot could she possibly have latched onto?

Without thinking much, Du Ziming stepped forward, trying to snatch Ning Qing away. Ning Qing instinctively shrank back into the man's arms.

Li Ren lowered his gaze to glance at her, then looked up again. His expression darkened, his dark eyes becoming even more unfathomably deep.

"Was it you who drugged her?"

Du Ziming found this somewhat inexplicable. He had already dropped the name of the Xinglong Gang, yet this man wasn't panicking in the slightest? Who in the underworld didn't know the reputation of the Xinglong Gang?

"Yeah, so what? Trying to be a hero, are you? I told you to put the fucking woman down! Didn't you hear..."

Before Du Ziming could finish his sentence, Jin Shui delivered a heavy, ringing slap across his face.

"Running your mouth with such filthy, uncultured nonsense? Even I didn't go to school for many years, but I don't fucking swear!"

This cold, thunderous strike instantly dropped Du Ziming to the floor. It took him a moment to react before he clutched his face and cried out.

This slap was delivered with full force, leaving a distinct palm print instantly raised on Du Ziming's face.

The few underlings behind him were so frightened by the sudden action that not a single one dared to step forward.

Du Ziming stared with wide eyes and roared in disbelief:

"You! Do you know who I am?! You dare hit me?"

Yin Shui's bright gaze was filled with oppressive intensity. He lowered his gaze to look down at him coolly and unhurriedly said:

"How dare you act so impudently in front of the Li family!"

"The Li family? Which Li family?"

"East City, Li Manor!"

Du Ziming narrowed his eyes, sizing up the few people in front of him.

In Country A, who didn't know of Li Manor? It was a fortress symbolizing wealth and power, the embodiment of the richest family, something ordinary people could only look up to.

If this man truly was that young master of the Li family, then as the son of the wealthiest man, he should have all sorts of beauties surrounding him. Why would he ever appear in a place like this?

Furthermore, how could a down-and-out woman like Ning Qing possibly have any ties to the Li family? And if it were truly someone from the Li family, how could his entourage consist of only these three bodyguards dressed in ordinary clothes?

He must be faking it!

"Still putting on an act? If you're the young master of the Li family, then I'm the head of the Li family!"

With that, Du Ziming motioned for his underlings to surround the three of them. Jin Shui and Yin Shui reacted instantly, moving to protect the front and back.

A fight was on the verge of breaking out.

You can never save someone who is hell-bent on courting death!

Jin Shui couldn't hold back a muffled chuckle:

"I'm afraid you don't have the life for it!"

Ning Qing forced herself to look up, gazing at the man before her. Although the effects of the drug had subsided quite a bit, she was still feeling dizzy and lightheaded.

Ning Qing listened with a hazy consciousness, her mind heavy and muddled.

She had heard of the Li family before. Their assets were in the tens of trillions; they were far more than just the richest family.

The Li family had influence in both the underworld and the upper circles, employing nearly a thousand lawyers alone. They were not only an invincible presence in Country A's business world, but they also possessed profound connections in politics, a truly terrifying existence holding overwhelming power.

Ha! He's quite clever, pretending to be someone few people recognize...

The young master of the Li family rarely showed his face and was known by almost no one. She herself had only heard rumors claiming that this young master was incompetent and utterly hideous in appearance.

Yet the man standing before her, calling his appearance "pleasing to the gods and men" wouldn't even do it justice!

She never expected that his rugged, rough exterior would be a complete polar opposite to the aura and actions he was about to unleash...

chapters.title: I Want to Play with Her, Any Problem?
chapters.content:
Pondering for a moment, Ning Qing fought through her discomfort and asked in a low voice:

"Pretending to be a member of the Li family like this... is not a good idea. You... you should just leave."

Li Ren chuckled lightly. Showing no panic at all, he said with helpless resignation:

"Wasn't it all to help you?"

?

"When did I ever..."

"Go to sleep. I won't hurt you."

A flash of confusion crossed Ning Qing's eyes, but she no longer had the strength to persuade him. Under the combined influence of the drug and the alcohol, she closed her eyes, dizzy and sweating.

For some reason, deep down she felt an inexplicable trust in him, and she actually drifted off into a deep sleep.

Li Ren cast a condescending look down at Du Ziming on the ground.

Remembering that he was still half-reclined, Du Ziming stood up with bulging veins, pointed fiercely at Li Ren, and cursed:

"You little punk! You still dare impersonate someone from the Li family! I'm going to teach you a real lesson today!"

Not far behind, Lin Yamei, who had overheard their argument, walked over in a rage. She marched straight up to Li Ren, pointed at them, and scolded:

"I don't care who you are, you death-seeking pieces of trash! Put that woman down right now! This has nothing to do with you!"

Jin Shui looked Lin Yamei up and down with annoyance, tilted his head, and asked:

"And who are you supposed to be?"

Du Ziming chimed in from the side with a smug smile:

"This is the eldest miss of the Lin Corporation!"

Jin Shui thought for a moment, then let out a disdainful laugh:

"Oh! I know. The Lin Corporation, isn't that the one that started out running fraud and prostitution rings?"

This breezy mockery instantly shattered Lin Yamei's composure. She pointed at Jin Shui and shrieked:

"I must be having terrible luck today! Every single one of you is completely blind! What street gang are you from to be so utterly clueless? Looking like a bunch of poor tramps, how dare you insult the Lin family?! Hand that woman over to me immediately, or else..."

Before she could finish, Lin Yamei felt her heart skip a beat, freezing her in place.

The icy tip of Jin Shui's silencer-equipped pistol was already pressed against her neck.

The blinding speed of the draw made Lin Yamei swallow hard, a look of sheer terror washing over her.

Du Ziming was also stunned for a moment before stammering:

"S-she is the eldest miss of the Lin Corporation! You dare pull a gun? Aren't you afraid of the Lin family's retaliation leaving you without a burial place?!"

Jin Shui couldn't help but chuckle. The Lin family? They weren't even worthy of carrying the Li family's shoes, yet they dared to bark.

"What? Shall I deal with you first, then?"

"You..."

For a moment, the atmosphere plunged to freezing point.

Yin Shui glanced at Jin Shui and gave a slight shake of his head, a trace of helplessness flashing in his eyes.

He was always this impulsive and flashy. They still had serious business to attend to today, what a blockhead!

Coming to this club today was meant to catch Lin Munan, the husband of the eldest Miss Li, yet they were wasting time here. If the head of the family found out, the master would be in for another earful.

Yin Shui was just about to open his mouth to remind him when a hurried set of footsteps and shouts interrupted his thoughts. The newcomer was Xiang Jinsheng, the owner of the club.

"What's going on here? No fighting, don't come to blows!"

Judging by this setup, the two sides were about to throw down!

Jin Shui rolled his eyes:

"Here comes another one. Will this ever end?"

Upon seeing Xiang Jinsheng, Lin Yamei seized the opportunity to take a step back, creating some distance. She pointed at Xiang Jinsheng and said:

"Are you the owner? This guy snatched the woman we called for, and even pulled a gun on me! If you don't handle this properly for me today, you'll regret it!"

Xiang Jinsheng had extensive connections and knew almost all the prominent figures in Jiang'an City.

Sweeping his gaze over the man before him, he felt an inexplicable sense of deja vu. He stepped forward with an ingratiating smile and said:

"Sir, is there some sort of misunderstanding here? The Gilded Club is a place for people to relax and have fun. How did things turn into this?"

Li Ren tilted his head slightly, the corner of his mouth curving into a dangerous arc.

"Since it's a place for fun, I want to play with her. Any problem?"

True to his creed of keeping the peace to make money, Xiang Jinsheng still found himself torn between laughter and tears upon hearing this.

This kid hadn't even booked a private room or paid any money, yet he was outright snatching people?

"This gentleman doesn't seem to frequent places like this very much; I suppose you're not very familiar with the rules. She's just a woman! We have plenty of them here. How about I call a few better ones for you to take your pick? My treat! How does that sound?"

Lin Yamei chimed in relentlessly as well:

"Trying to snatch someone from me? You truly don't know the immensity of heaven and earth! And you even dare impersonate the Li family! I'll make sure you die a horribly ugly death!"

The Li family?

Xiang Jinsheng looked at him in surprise, staring fixedly at Li Ren as memories gradually surged in his mind.

The vague figure in his mind merged perfectly with the man before him. He couldn't help trembling all over, a chill rising from the depths of his heart.

Oh, heavens above! Isn't this the Li family's young master, Li Ren?!

Why has this titan of a Buddha come here?!

Xiang Jinsheng hurriedly pulled Lin Yamei back, his eyes filled with heavy hints, as if telling her: Stop courting death! He is someone you cannot afford to offend!

Little did he know, Lin Yamei's temper had flared up. Completely missing Xiang Jinsheng's warning, she marched right up to Jin Shui and roared:

"I am locking horns with you today! If I don't beat you until you're begging on your knees, I'll be your grandson!"

"Miss Lin! Stop talking..."

Xiang Jinsheng's face was practically twisted into a knot. It wouldn't matter if Lin Yamei wanted to court death on her own, but if the young master of the Li family was injured on his premises, his club would essentially be finished!

"Let's all calm down, it's just a small matter. This is no place for a fight..."

"Not a place for a fight? Then is it a place for killing?"

Jin Shui raised an eyebrow, interrupting Xiang Jinsheng's words, his eyes brimming with hostility.

At these words, Lin Yamei's anger nearly blew off the top of her skull. Veins bulged on her forehead as she glared in a fit of rage.

Has the sky in Jiang'an turned upside down? Even the Lin family and the Xinglong Gang wouldn't dare talk about killing people so casually!

Hearing this, Xiang Jinsheng mentally lit a stick of incense for Lin Yamei. He didn't even dare try to persuade them anymore; saving his own skin was paramount!

"Enough!"

A low, impatient roar plunged the entire space into instant silence.

Li Ren exhaled softly, the chilling aura radiating from his entire body making anyone reluctant to approach him.

This woman was really solid. Holding her for this long, she was actually quite heavy.

Jin Shui sensibly retreated to the side and stood at attention respectfully, almost forgetting that there was a far more important matter awaiting them today.

Li Ren cast a sidelong glance at Lin Yamei, his eyes opening to speak softly as if staring at a dead man:

"Miss Lin, care to yield her to me?"

His low, hoarse voice directed at Lin Yamei carried a murderous intent cold enough to plunge someone into an ice cellar. Calling it a "yield" made it sound much more like a robbery.

"Yield my foot! What kind of big shot are you pretending to be here?"

Xiang Jinsheng watched Lin Yamei and shook his head inwardly, what a pity.

Unfortunately, the brainless Lin Yamei failed to pick up on the danger signals and was still howling in a display of unyielding ignorance.

Li Ren looked at Lin Yamei with an expression that seemed to show appreciation for her, then turned his clear, handsome eyes to Jin Shui and said:

"Hurry it up. We have real business."

Jin Shui nodded respectfully:

"Understood!"

"And that woman, Yin Shui, handle her yourself."

Jin Shui and Yin Shui followed the direction of Li Ren's gaze to Lin Yamei, understanding instantly.

"Yes, Sir!"

With that, Li Ren turned around and walked away, carrying Ning Qing without looking back, completely ignoring the shrieks of Lin Yamei echoing behind him.

A murderous grin instantly bloomed on Jin Shui's face. He put away his gun, slowly rolled up his sleeves to reveal the sharp, defined muscles of his forearms, and crooked his finger in a provocative gesture:

"Come on together, I'm pressed for time!"

Yin Shui stepped back behind Jin Shui.

Du Ziming spat on the floor and roared at his underlings:

"Get them! Fuck! Are you idiots? Beat them! Beat them to death!"

The underlings snapped out of their daze and lunged fiercely toward the center.

One of them tried to circle around to pursue Li Ren, but Yin Shui with lightning-fast reflexes grabbed him by the hair on his forehead.

A precise knee strike slammed squarely into the man's head, smashing him heavily to the ground.

chapters.title: Not even a minute!
chapters.content:
"Ah..."

The lackey passed out instantly.

Jin Shui charged like a fierce tiger descending a mountain toward the several people approaching head-on, his fists falling like raindrops, every single strike exceptionally vicious.

In an instant, screams of agony echoed throughout the corridor.

Xiang Jinsheng wasn't surprised in the least. How could Lin Yamei possibly afford to provoke people from the Li family?

In less than a minute, over a dozen lackeys fell one after another like dominoes, lying on the ground with wails rising and falling in succession. Blood stained the floor, and three of them had already fainted on the spot.

Although Lin Yamei hadn't been hit, she was so frightened by the sudden bloody scene that her eyes widened, and she covered her mouth, silently retreating to a corner.

Xiang Jinsheng prayed silently in his heart, terrified that any single member of the Li family might suffer even the slightest harm.

Jin Shui shook his wrist as if still unsatisfied, and looked at Yin Shui with a smug smile:

"Done. Not even a minute!"

Yin Shui curved his lips into a smile and patted Jin Shui's shoulder:

"I'll go ahead to see the Master. You cover the rear."

With that, he turned and walked away.

Jin Shui cast a cold glance at everyone present, the corners of his mouth curling into an imperceptible smirk.

He gently pulled the sharp dagger from his waist, sliding his fingertips lightly along the blade, making a faint, piercing sound.

"Still coming or not?"

The few conscious lackeys in the corridor looked back and forth at Lin Yamei with shrinking expressions.

"Miss... Miss, these two black behemoths are not to be trifled with. Should we get out of here?"

Lin Yamei thought for a moment, then anxiously shoved Xiang Jinsheng and said:

"Boss, hurry up and call your men! This is your territory; are you really going to let these bastards bully me like this?! I see you want to close down for good tomorrow, don't you!"

Xiang Jinsheng was almost so angry he laughed. He took the walkie-talkie from his waist and called for security.

Lin Yamei thought resentfully to herself: Let's see how you escape this time!

Soon, all twenty-odd security guards arrived on the scene. However, Xiang Jinsheng suddenly changed direction, pointed at Lin Yamei and her group, and shouted:

"Throw them all out of here!"

Lin Yamei widened her eyes in astonishment at Xiang Jinsheng, her face full of disbelief.

"Boss Xiang, have you lost your mind? It's our people who got beaten! How can you..."

"Enough! That gentleman just now is the young master of the Li family! You don't even know who you've offended! This time, nobody can protect you! That woman is someone Young Master Li has taken a fancy to, and you still wanted to snatch her? I kindly warned you! You can't blame me, you brought this death upon yourself!"

Xiang Jinsheng's deep voice made Lin Yamei and Du Ziming freeze in place as if struck by five bolts of lightning.

"What? How is this possible..."

Xiang Jinsheng's certain gaze was like pronouncing a death sentence upon Lin Yamei.

"It's over... I've really brought a catastrophe upon myself this time!"

The young master of the Li family; what difference was there between offending him and offending the King of Hell? How could she possibly afford to provoke him?

This time, she had truly provoked the absolute last person she should have crossed!

---

Li Ren sent Ning Qing to a hotel and settled her in. After that, he and Yin Shui went to a private room, and Yin Shui kicked the door open with great force.

With a loud bang.

Inside the private box, a group of people were still laughing and drinking amidst billowing smoke. Several men and women were in a state of disarray, acting dissolutely.

Seeing someone barge through the door, they all quieted down, wanting to know who had a death wish to dare crash the gathering of the Li family's son-in-law.

The leader, Lin Munan, biting down on a cigarette, stood up indignantly and shouted:

"Which motherfucker has a death wish?"

With that, he stood up and walked over aggressively, but suddenly, his footsteps came to a halt.

"It's me motherfucker crashing your door! Brother-in-law, you sure made me look hard for you!"

"Li, Li Ren?"

Li Ren propped himself against the door with one hand in a casual manner, sweeping a condescending gaze over the crowd. A faint smile curved his stern face, as if the King of Hell was judging a bunch of unjustly dead souls.

"Having fun, are we?"

"B-Big brother! Why are you here? No! I'm talking business! This is President Ma's gathering, I was called here by him."

Hearing this, Lin Munan turned to look at Ma Ziqiang, who was calmly holding a wine glass and watching with a cold gaze.

Lin Munan suddenly woke up to reality.

His whereabouts today should have been known to no one. It must have been Ma Ziqiang who leaked it to Li Ya! That was why this malevolent little brother-in-law had been sent to drag him back!

Without time to think further, Li Ren leaned down and slowly drew a dagger from the edge of his boot. His relaxed hair swayed slightly in front of his brow, and wearing a dangerous smile, he walked up to Lin Munan and pressed the blade right against his neck.

Lin Munan quickly raised both hands in a surrender gesture and said:

"Don't! Big brother! We're all family, let's talk this out!"

"Family? You're out here living it up, how come you didn't bring me along? Done playing yet? Are you coming with me for a trip?"

"Done, I'm done! We'll go right now! You... put the knife down first!"

With a smile that didn't quite reach his eyes, Li Ren put the dagger away and grabbed him by the back of the neck, hoisting him out as easily as if he were carrying a little chick.

Ma Ziqiang, sitting on the sofa behind them, revealed a triumphant smile and took a silent drag of his cigarette.

As for this useless piece of trash Lin Munan, a kept son-in-law, he actually wanted to snatch territory from him? In your dreams! You're going to get what's coming to you this time!

---

Half an hour later, inside the Li family mansion.

Li Zhili sat upright, his eyes as dark as obsidian, expressionless.

Beside him, his daughter Li Ya was covered in haute couture jewelry, looking as magnificent as a princess. Her pretty mouth was pouted in dissatisfaction, her legs crossed, and her expression somewhat impatient.

Seeing Li Ren bring Lin Munan arriving fashionably late, she immediately complained:

"I just asked you to catch someone, why did it take you so long!"

"Ran into some trouble, got delayed."

Li Ren tossed Lin Munan onto the floor, his slender figure stepping past him to sit on the sofa. He wore the expression of someone watching a good show, lacking only a handful of melon seeds.

"I'm asking you, were there women in his private room?"

"Mm, quite a few. They were having a pretty high-energy time."

Upon hearing this, Li Ya angrily walked up to Lin Munan, her eyes filled with fury as she rebuked him:

"Lin Munan, I never realized you had such guts! You dare go to a nightclub to look for hostesses?"

Lin Munan hurriedly scrambled up, kneeling straight on the floor, and explained to Li Ya and Li Zhili:

"Ya! I went there to talk about official business! That Ma Ziqiang invited me, it was about the land plot in Nanlin! It was just business socializing, it's a misunderstanding!"

"A misunderstanding? What kind of business socializing requires going to a nightclub to discuss?"

Li Zhili glanced over and slowly stood up, walking toward him. A crushing sense of pressure washed over the room, making Lin Munan swallow hard, his gaze filled with a trace of panic.

"F-Father, I really went to talk business! I swear! Ya! You have to believe me!"

Li Zhili reined in his anger and said sternly:

"Munan, since Ma Ziqiang has already seen through your plan regarding the Nanlin land, you don't need to get involved anymore. If you act without a sense of propriety again, I won't spare you! Understood?"

Lin Munan immediately nodded like pounding garlic:

"Understood, understood!"

Li Zhili didn't say any more. He cast a cold glance at Li Ren and strode away.

Lin Munan let out a deep breath, cautiously lowered his head, and glanced sideways at Li Ren, only to run right into his gloomy, icy gaze, which sent an involuntary shudder through Lin Munan's body.

That goddamned brother-in-law!

Li Ya let out a cold snort, turned around, and walked toward her bedroom. Lin Munan scrambled to his feet and hurried to follow her.

Li Ren's fathomless eyes stared fixedly at the direction they had left, a bone-deep chill rising in his eyes.

Butler Lu Zhong walked over with a solemn expression.

"Young Master, it seems the head of the family really intends to let Lin Munan inherit the Li Corporation. I must report this to the old master!"

Li Ren let out a soft scoff, though his eyes remained calmly cold.

chapters.title: Wouldn't it be better if he died?
chapters.content:
"There's no need to let Grandfather know."

Lu Zhong shook his head and slowly said:

"Young Master, are you really not going to fight for it anymore? Come to think of it, you came to the Li family when you were only three years old. Ever since Madam passed away, the head of the family has become even more unscrupulous! I'm afraid he's forgotten that if not for you, the Li family wouldn't be where it is today..."

Lu Zhong's eyes carried a glimmer of hope. In this household, who had true ability was something he saw clearly.

Li Ren gave a self-deprecating chuckle, then lightly patted Lu Zhong's shoulder:

"I'm heading out, Uncle Lu."

---

"Young Master, it's so late, are you still going back to the Half-Mountain Villa? Why not stay the night at the Li family mansion?"

"No, I have things to take care of."

Lu Zhong's expression turned somewhat worried.

"At this hour, what could possibly need tending to? Is the head of the family sending you on another dangerous mission?"

Li Ren shook his head. At the thought of Ning Qing's face, the corners of his mouth unconsciously curled upward.

"No, I'm... going to deal with a gang with whom I have a personal feud."

Hearing this, Lu Zhong grew anxious. He grabbed him by the arm with one hand and asked worriedly:

"Young Master, you're always getting mixed up in these things, you must be careful! The old master has always been worried about you."

Li Ren lowered his gaze for a moment, then said calmly:

"Would it... not be better if I died? That would end all troubles once and for all."

"Young Master!"

Seeing Lu Zhong's panicked reaction, Li Ren switched to a joking tone.

"I'm just kidding! Don't worry, I certainly won't die before Grandfather!"

"You brat! You shouldn't say things like that!"

Li Ren gave a soft chuckle, waved his hand with a dashing back turned, and said no more.

---

Three days later, the Golden Age Club.

Ning Qing was alone in her dorm room, practicing with her customized triangular darts with a blank expression. The darts were about ten centimeters long with sharp points at both ends, and their edges flashed with a fierce, chilling glint. Darts of this weight carried plenty of force to inflict serious injury, and taking a life was well within their capability.

Over the past few years, she had practiced until she could hit her target with pinpoint accuracy within ten meters.

The deep-seated blood feud was something she never dared forget for even a moment.

I will definitely find the culprits and avenge you with my own hands!

This dormitory, converted from a storage room of barely a dozen square meters, was her living quarters; a foothold she had begged Boss Xiang for.

Over the past three years, although she earned quite a bit, it was still a drop in the bucket compared to the bottomless pit of medical expenses.

After the events of that day, she had woken up in a hotel. She had been changed into clean clothes, and the wound on her leg had even been treated.

Over the past few days, that face always surfaced in her mind, lingering like a ghost.

Who on earth was that man? How could he have safely extricated himself from the encirclement of the eldest miss of the Lin family and the Xinglong Gang, and brought her to a hotel?

Ning Qing instinctively felt that he was no ordinary person.

Not to mention that physique; wheat-colored, muscular build, dressed in pitch-black from head to toe, he practically looked like a large black bear.

Handsome, ruthless, wild, and carrying a hint of a dangerous aura that she couldn't quite put into her finger.

Just as her mind drifted, Ning Qing's phone suddenly rang. It was her childhood friend, Xue Yi.

"Qingqing, is your leg feeling better?"

"Much better. I'm going in for work tonight."

"Alright. I went to check on Auntie."

"Mm, thank you for your hard work, Xue Yi. Thank you for going to see my mom for me."

"Why are you still saying things like that to me? Qingqing, I really think you should quit this job. This kind of line of work; it's bound to happen sooner or later. Walk by the river often enough, and you're bound to get your shoes wet. You'll always run into difficult customers..."

"Xue Yi, thank you, but please don't say those things anymore. You know my situation. I have to get my revenge. As long as I'm still breathing, I will uncover the truth and slay the culprits with my own hands, so that this lifetime won't have been lived in vain! As for the consequences, I don't care anymore."

A soft sigh came from the other end of the phone. He knew that trying to persuade her further was futile.

After chatting for a few more moments, she numbly hung up the phone.

Ning Qing's thoughts involuntarily drifted back to that night three years ago; that fire had changed everything.

Driven to a dead end, she had sold her dignity to become a hostess, all for the sake of avenging that blood feud, regardless of the cost to her mother.

Suppressing her tears, Ning Qing composed her emotions and walked toward the wall, her eyes flashing with resolve and determination.

The wall was plastered with clues and information about her revenge that she had gathered over the past three years. After numerous investigations, she had ruled out her second uncle, fourth uncle, and aunt. There had been many suspicious elements surrounding the incident back then, and the investigating police hadn't found anything unusual. Although there were traces of arson, the arsonist had never been found, and even the surveillance footage had been mysteriously erased.

As for her, the one thing she had in abundance was time. Even if it took her entire life, she would find the perpetrators!

---

Nighttime.

Ning Qing stepped into the dressing room as usual.

Lily, the manager, fluttered lightly over to her side.

"Qing, why didn't you call me about what happened last time! If I'd known, I definitely would have had the security guards throw her out!"

Call her? She took money and couldn't hide fast enough! How could she possibly care whether Ning Qing lived or died?

No fluctuation showed on Ning Qing's face. She offered a calm, elegant smile:

"It's fine, it's all in the past."

"Madam Lily, why are you still worrying about her! For our esteemed Miss Ning, handling a few men is a breeze, isn't it?"

The voice belonged to Ling Xiahe, who had always looked down on Ning Qing.

"She's a rich miss after all, would she be afraid of a few punks? I heard that Du Ziming, the young master of the Xinglong Gang, even slipped her a drug."

Ling Xiahe had no intention of holding back. She sauntered over seductively, continuing her blatant provocation against Ning Qing.

Several other women nearby joined in as well:

"They say the Xinglong Gang's drugs are so potent even a woman of iron can't resist them. How could she possibly have escaped?"

"Tsk tsk tsk! And here I thought she was so pure! Acting all high and mighty just to spin stories and fool who? Her legs even got roughed up!"

"That kind of skill is something the rest of us could never hope to learn!"

...

Listening to the increasingly piercing gossip around her, Ning Qing abruptly set her curling iron down on the table. A crisp "clack" echoed through the air, and her clear eyes instantly chilled as she looked around at the crowd.

The matters of that day involved far too many people; the fewer who knew, the better.

After a moment of thought, Ning Qing calmly replied:

"Believe it or not. Instead of wasting energy wagging your tongues like this, you'd better spend more time finding clients and opening tables. How many orders have you even pulled this month? How many shifts have you actually worked?"

"You, still acting arrogant! Aren't you just relying on acting all innocent!"

"If you're jealous, you can act innocent too."

"You..."

"Alright, Xiahe, stop bickering!"

The manager was in no mood to watch them bicker right now. She had just gotten a big piece of news and wanted to pry it out of Ning Qing.

Lily gestured for Ling Xiahe to shut her mouth. On the surface, she didn't dare push Ning Qing too hard; after all, she was her biggest cash cow.

With that, she waved her hand to scatter the other women.

With a face full of gossip, she turned back to Ning Qing and asked:

"Don't lower yourself to their level! Alright, ignore her. Tell me, what happened afterwards that day?"

Ning Qing lowered her gaze for a moment.

That large black bear; she probably wouldn't run into him again anyway. Better to avoid extra trouble.

"...After I escaped, I hid in a changing room stall. Then I passed out and don't remember anything else. Madam Lily, if the Xinglong Gang comes around again next time, let me know in advance so I can steer clear and avoid the trouble."

Ning Qing still didn't know that the person she thought she would never see again was about to show up... and nearly drive her out of her mind.

chapters.title: It really is him!
chapters.content:
The madam nodded, looking like she still hadn't had enough, curled her lips and said:

"Them? Ha! You don't know yet, do you? I was just about to ask you! I reckon they won't be able to come here anymore from now on!"

Ning Qing looked at her curiously, her dark eyebrows slightly furrowed.

"Not be able to come? What do you mean?"

"You didn't watch the news?"

"What news?"

Ning Qing widened her eyes and put down the cosmetics in her hand.

The madam put on the expression of someone who understood all the gossip in the world and said:

"You didn't know? It was so thrilling! Let me tell you! I heard on the news yesterday that after that day, the Du family head's and the Xinglong Gang's stronghold was wiped out by a mysterious organization, with heavy casualties, and the Xinglong Gang's young master Du Ziming even went missing! Some people say a mysterious organization wiped out the Xinglong Gang overnight, they're simply modern-day chivalrous heroes!"

Zhang Yining, who was sitting nearby and had a good relationship with Ning Qing, perked up her ears and leaned closer, saying with a bit of gloating:

"You have to say, this Xinglong Gang is also a well-known organization in the underworld, who has the ability to wipe them out overnight? Tsk! Qingqing, they must have done too many evil things, someone couldn't stand the sight of them anymore!"

The madam chimed in:

"Yeah, the very second day after they bullied Qingqing, retribution arrived right away!"

"You can say that again!"

……

Listening to this, Ning Qing could only find it unbelievable.

The Xinglong Gang destroyed overnight? The young master missing?

Isn't this too much of a coincidence! She always felt something was a bit strange.

Could it be…… that man?

If it really was him, one truly cannot judge a book by its cover. What on earth is his background?

Before she could think too much, someone outside the lounge called out for the madam.

It was time, time to go to work.

"Alright! Evil gets its reward, Qing, let's go! Time to make some money!"

The madam's voice pulled Ning Qing back from her thoughts. She stood up, straightened her clothes, and prepared to take clients with a contemplative expression. The madam had also gone out first to ask about the guests' preferences.

A few minutes later, Ning Qing was all cleaned up and dressed, and Lily had also returned, though she was still muttering under her breath:

"What kind of deity of a guest is it today? There's a big shot who came and said he wants all the women to go over... Could he be a major client?"

With that thought, the madam shouted to the nearly one hundred women filling the lounge:

"Everyone, listen up! Molly's group, cc's group, Miaomiao's group, and Dandan's group, all of you together! We've got work! Look lively, all of you!"

Everyone grew restless, and even some of the women who hadn't gotten a shift in days perked up.

A moment later, everyone stood in several rows and was led by the madam and Lily to the door of the presidential suite, lining up in five queues according to their looks and grades.

Ning Qing, as the club's facade, stood at the very end of the fifth group.

The madam went in first to greet the guests and pour drinks, coming out a moment later with a beaming smile, carrying a heavy bag of money which she handed to her assistant Xiao Li to go put away.

The smile on her face was practically blooming as she said to everyone:

"You better all put on a good performance for me! This lord is a big spender! Anyone who dares to offend him will get a taste of my wrath! First team, follow me first! ... Look lively! You, pull your neckline lower! Who is that? Take off your coat! What are you doing? Move, move, move..."

Everyone grew excited, all hoping to catch the eye of this big shot of considerable background.

However, as the first, second, and third teams came out one after another, not a single person had been chosen. Ning Qing suddenly had an ominous premonition. She grabbed someone coming out of the third group and asked:

"Still not a single one taken?"

"Yeah! What a pity! I guess only you last two groups will be able to catch his eye!"

"Um, let me ask, what do the guests inside look like? How many of them?"

"There are three people. The one in the middle should be the leader. He's so handsome and very tall, but he doesn't feel like a proper person. His face is dark, looking at him makes your heart flutter with panic..."

Tall? Three people? Dark face?

Why does it feel like that man from the other day?

Ning Qing broke out in a bit of a cold sweat, unconsciously biting her lower lip as an inexplicable fear and strange premonition welled up in her heart.

She recalled that day; after she fainted, she had no idea what the situation was.

Could that man have been taught a lesson by Lin Yamei and come to settle accounts with her?

Or did he want to do something improper to her again?

If that really was the case, since she didn't know much about him, wouldn't she be at a disadvantage once more?

Besides, what he did to her that day; he was definitely no good guy...

Thinking of this, Ning Qing couldn't help but feel nervous and jittery.

Seeing the fourth team go in as well, the more Ning Qing thought about it, the more unsettled her heart became, and she grew even more convinced that her guess was correct.

She couldn't help but stealthily walk to the door, using her work badge to block her face as she cast a sideways glance into the private room, and then she took a deep breath, took a quick stride, and hurried back to the end of the line.

It really was him!

That man, and there were two others beside him, the left and right guardian-like thugs from last time, all dressed in black, faces included.

They were simply banes!

The only difference from last time was that they were dressed much more exquisitely compared to their rough-and-tumble look then.

The man was holding a cigar, his expression somewhat impatient, and he looked to be in a very bad mood...

Standing blankly at the end of the line, Ning Qing's expression shifted from shock to panic, to a pale complexion, then her eyes rolled and she made up her mind.

Finally, after thinking twice in a super short amount of time, taking advantage of everyone's inattention, she executed her silent footsteps and, slipped away unassumingly!

If she didn't leave now, she'd be walking straight into the muzzle of a gun! If she couldn't afford to provoke them, she could at least hide from them! She just wanted to make money; she didn't want to mess with big shots like this again!

The women of the fourth team came out, discussing it with unwillingness:

"Why is it still a complete shutout? This lord is too picky, isn't he?"

"Exactly! It's already dozens of people, and he still doesn't like any of them!"

"I'm afraid even if he picks someone, this money won't be easy to make! He looks like someone you really shouldn't mess with..."

The madam waved her hand impatiently and said:

"Alright, alright! Stop talking, fifth team, go on in, be a bit more flirtatious! If you can't even keep a big shot like this, you lot are completely useless!"

The last team accordingly entered the private room.

On the sofa, Li Ren leaned lazily against the backrest, mindfully toying with a string of Buddhist prayer beads in his hand.

His indifferent, deep brow and eyes swept a glance across them before his expression gradually turned cold.

The women wore sweet, alluring smiles, striking poses and full of charm, but in his eyes, they just flashed past without lingering for even a second.

"Boss! These are the last ones, and also the best ones we have! Still no one you like?"

Jin Shui beside him was utterly lacking in interest, while Yin Shui pursed his lips, clearly missing that certain young lady, and asked the madam:

"Are these all of them?"

"Yes, every single woman in the entire club is right here!"

"The person we want is missing."

"Ah?"

The madam swept her gaze across the women uncomprehendingly before noticing the abnormality.

Huh? Where was Ning Qing?

She was the club's facade; she was clearly just here a moment ago, how could she be gone?

The madam forced a couple of dry laughs on her face, got up, casually grabbed Ling Xiahe's hand, and dragged her in front of Yin Shui.

"How could that be? Take a look, Lord, these are all top-tier goods! This one is also great! Her waist is super flexible! Does the lord like her?"

Ling Xiahe hurriedly pulled her neckline even lower, pushed out her chest tenderly, gazed at Yin Shui with watery eyes, and sent out wave after wave of flirtatious glances.

Yin Shui, who had never seen this kind of formation, swallowed awkwardly and hurriedly averted his eyes.

Although this one had plenty of kick... she wasn't the person Young Master Li wanted!

Jin Shui watched and couldn't help laughing, biting his lip and not daring to laugh out loud.

Even a slow-witted guy like him could tell that the woman from the other day was far more than dozens of times prettier than these ones.

Her temperament, figure, appearance, and posture far surpassed them all.

chapters.title: Serve me well, and nothing will happen
chapters.content:
Before Yin Shui could speak, a low, sexy voice rang out.

"Out, all of you! You, ten minutes, bring her here."

Li Ren tilted his head, indifferent to the bone, looking at the madam without even moving an eyebrow.

Although it was a remark devoid of emotion, the madam felt as if a basin of ice water had been poured all over her body, and cold sweat broke out profusely.

She wondered inwardly, how did this lord know there was still a Ning Qing who hadn't come? Did they know each other? If they knew each other, why didn't he just call her name and tell her directly?

Yin Shui glanced at Li Ren, knowing he was angry, and gave the madam a hint:

"Think carefully again, who else hasn't come?"

The madam was stunned for a moment. Oh, mother! What kind of guests were these every day? It was as if if she couldn't bring the person in ten minutes, what awaited her would be hell!

The madam wisely took the hint. Since the other women weren't to his liking, she slapped her forehead and said:

"Oh! Right! I remember now! There was still one more just now, she probably went to the washroom! So the lord had someone specific in mind! Why didn't you say so earlier! Right away!"

With that, the madam smiled brightly and led the people out.

Jin Shui curled his lips into a smile and said:

"That young lady, I'm afraid she slipped away?"

Yin Shui also chimed in:

"It's rare for Sir to take a fancy to a woman, only to be politely turned down."

Having followed Li Ren for so many years and watching his own young master walk the edge of a blade year round, acting tyrannically and ruthlessly with never a woman by his side...

it was finally rare for him to find someone he could look at, otherwise, they really would have thought something was wrong with his body...

Fortunately, it was a false alarm.

"Whoever Sir has his eyes on definitely won't be able to run!"

"Our Sir usually doesn't care for women. For him to fancy her is doing her a favor! How could she still refuse?"

"Nonsense, I think that young lady was scared off..."

Li Ren wore a hint of cordial a smile, narrowed his eyes and looked at Jin Shui, interrupting their chatter.

Jin Shui was frozen by the free-flowing cold air. The expression on his face gradually froze, and he felt as uncomfortable as if a hole had been stared into his body. He hurriedly corrected himself:

"Sir! We'll wait outside! If that madam doesn't bring the person here in ten minutes, I'll make someone bleed on the spot!"

Jin Shui exchanged a look with Yin Shui and, fleeing like frightened rabbits, took a mere two seconds to sprint out the door.

A second later and they'd probably be taking a blade...

It was rare for him to bring them out to have fun today, and now look at that; the alcohol wouldn't be drunk, and the women wouldn't be held either.

---

Over here, the madam jogged to the dressing room to find Ning Qing, but after wandering around the large dressing room, she didn't see a single shadow.

"This damn girl, where did she run off to..."

Ling Xiahe nearby saw her looking for someone, walked over and asked:

"Madam Lily, who are you looking for?"

"Ning Qing, did you see her? She won't answer her phone, and she won't reply to messages. Is she slacking off during work hours?"

Ling Xiahe rolled her eyes with annoyance and said:

"Didn't see her! Who knows what tricks she's pulling again!"

"Seriously! What an ancestor!"

The madam poked her head out to look around everywhere. Not seeing anyone, she sent a message giving an ultimatum:

'Ning Qing! The guest in the presidential suite is giving fifty thousand [yuan]! Fifty thousand! Are you not going to make money anymore? Fine! If you don't come out again, you can pack your bags and leave!'

Over in the dorms, Ning Qing was hiding and looking at the string of incoming messages. She frowned helplessly and tiptoed back a reply:

'Madam Lily, I'm not feeling well, I went back to the dorm. I'm sorry, why don't you have someone else step in? I'll take a leave today, giving this money for other sisters to earn is the same! I believe you can definitely handle it!'

'Where is it that easy? The man specifically asked for you! You want me to shove someone else in there? Besides, I just tried that too... Where are you not feeling well? You were full of life just a moment ago! It's just taking a client, can that man eat you alive?'

Hearing this, Ning Qing couldn't help closing her eyes and sighing.

Not to mention, she really did feel like that man looked like he wanted to tear her apart alive...

That burly figure, that dark face like the King of Hell, and the murderous intent in those eyes... It seemed crushing her to death would be as easy as pinching an ant.

Going to see a banish-worthy weirdo who dared to impersonate the Li family; wasn't that just asking for trouble?

Just as Ning Qing hesitated for a moment without replying, the madam's voice messages came in one after another like machine-gun fire, beeping incessantly like a death talisman.

Ning Qing simply tossed her phone under the pillow.

After a brief two or three minutes of quiet, Ning Qing suddenly felt an ominous premonition well up in her heart.

Sure enough, a hurried knock sounded.

Outside the door was the madam's continuous bombardment.

Ning Qing gritted her teeth, a flash of wit striking her. Her clear eyes glanced at the table drawer in front of her, a cunning smile emerged, and she made up her mind.

She walked over, picked up a small bottle filled with grey powder, gently caressed the bottle body, and a trace of coldness flashed in her eyes.

Since she couldn't hide, if he dared to do anything to her, this time she'd teach that big black bear a lesson so he'd know she wasn't someone to be bullied!

Taking advantage of someone's vulnerability last time, and now he even dared to come looking for her; you forced this on me!

Afterwards, Ning Qing put the medicine away and opened the door.

"Madam Lily, I..."

"Move!"

"Huh?"

The madam didn't waste words. She grabbed Ning Qing, muttered under her breath, and jogged toward the destination while subconsciously glancing at the time on her phone.

"Madam Lily, is it... is it really this urgent?"

Ning Qing asked breathlessly as she was being dragged along. The madam said hurriedly:

"Hurry up! That guest probably hasn't seen a woman in his entire life... Get a move on!"

Running all the way to the door of the private room, her voice arrived before she did.

"Lord! She's here! Isn't she a stunner? Her name is Ning Qing! Is she the one you were looking for?"

Ning Qing looked uncomprehendingly at Jin Shui and Yin Shui standing outside the door like two dark-skinned Vajra guardians.

The security guard beside them looked petite and pitiful.

Yin Shui nodded, then dismissed the madam and the security guard.

Jin Shui respectfully pushed open the door, slightly bent his waist, and extended a hand to invite her inside.

"Miss Ning, Sir is waiting for you, please go in!"

Ning Qing stood fixedly in place, still panting slightly. She intentionally or unintentionally cast a few glances inside before finally lifting her foot and walking in.

The dim lighting was very alluring.

Ning Qing stood blankly by the door like a sucker, calmed her hurried heartbeat from running, and cautiously sized up the man sitting on the sofa.

His exquisite dark suit had unbuttoned fasteners, his legs were crossed casually, and the straps of his holster were faintly visible through his shirt, outlining his perfect figure. The dim lighting sculpted his cold, stern face, and his wheat-colored skin faintly revealed an untamed wildness.

Today he looked very different from last time.

However, his gaze, it still felt like he was about to eat her up.

Li Ren raised his eyes to stare at her like he was admiring his prey, his sharp gaze softening only after she walked in.

"Why are you just standing there? I paid money, is this the kind of service I get?"

Hearing this, Ning Qing's heart trembled as memories of last time rushed back into her mind.

"You... what are you looking for me for?"

Li Ren sneered and said:

"What for? Where is this?"

Wasn't it obvious enough? It was plainly to have you.

Afterwards, he pursed his lips at Ning Qing, signaling her to sit next to him.

Ning Qing fidgeted and sat down on the sofa near the door, saying with some vigilance:

"Last time... you already treated me with disrespect! What do you want this time?"

She was quite sharp-tongued.

Li Ren curled his lips, his tone calm:

"Serve me well, and nothing will happen."

His words carried a trace of warning as he pointed to the spot beside him like an order.

Ning Qing definitely wouldn't have anticipated what would come next: she almost got forcefully taken by him right here...

chapters.title: Just call me A-Ren
chapters.content:
"Come here." A statement that brooked no refusal.

Ning Qing thought for a moment, then reluctantly got up and sat down a meter away from him.

Li Ren was clearly dissatisfied with this distance. He glanced at her sideways and said:

"I'm curious, is this how you usually earn money?"

Ning Qing said with a cold face:

"Yes, exactly like this."

Hearing this, Li Ren sneered,

"Although I don't come to places like this often, I know what kind of places they are. With professional ethics like yours, you might as well just resign."

Professional ethics? I've been a hostess for three years, what kind of situations haven't I seen? Do I need you to teach me?

Ning Qing hardened her heart, got up, sat down beside him, squeezed out a fake professional smile, and picked up an empty glass.

Looking at the man's face from such a close distance, Ning Qing couldn't help but swallow.

The man in front of her had slightly drooping long eyelashes, sharp yet delicate features, a high nose bridge, straight-slanting outer corners of the eyes, deep eye sockets, and ink-black pupils that seemed bottomless.

His jawline was particularly exceptional. He was wearing a well-fitted haute couture suit, and his long legs were casually crossed.

Relaxed yet languid, regal yet rebellious; completely different from the rough-and-ready look he had last time.

Such casual attire possessed a breathtaking handsomeness.

To be honest, despite having seen countless men, she had never seen one this handsome. She couldn't help but marvel at the exquisite craftsmanship of Goddess Nüwa...

She was momentarily dazed.

A trace of impatience appeared in Li Ren's eyes, and he asked emotionlessly, "Have you seen enough?"

Embarrassed for a second, Ning Qing quickly recovered her professional composure, hurriedly poured a drink, and handed it to him.

"Cheers, sir!"

As long as he doesn't give me a hard time, get through this, take the money, and it's done!

Then forget about this episode and get on with my revenge!

Ning Qing stared at the man with her grape-like eyes, which she had practiced using with seductive, lingering gazes countless times.

She knew no man could bear to give a hard time to a look like that!

"Are you here specifically to find me this time?"

Li Ren curved his lips into a slight smile and took the glass.

"Mm."

What else? Not to mention that she was taking advantage of the favor she owed him; she really had helped her, and she hadn't thanked him properly yet.

Li Ren took a small sip, leaned forward to grab a cigarette, and Ning Qing, with quick eyes and fast hands, snatched it and held it to his lips.

This sudden display of resourcefulness stunned Li Ren for a second.

Then he took the cigarette, bit lightly on the filter, and eyed this stunning woman whose aura was so out of place in this venue.

Ning Qing obediently picked up the lighter to help him light it.

However, after fumbling for a while, she couldn't even open the lid of the lighter.

Li Ren watched her every move, keeping a poker face.

Damn it! I've never seen this model before!

Seeing her struggle for a bit with an embarrassed look, Li Ren naturally reached out and steadied her hand.

"Like this, open the lid, turn the side a bit, and press down, yeah."

Ning Qing gently brought it to Li Ren's lips.

Li Ren took a puff, blew the smoke to the other side, and asked flatly:

"Is this how you usually serve people?"

"Usually... um, yes! Sir, may I ask your name?"

When is she ever this careful usually? With just this face of hers, which man could refuse?

Li Ren found Ning Qing's high-pitched, sweet, cloying voice a bit difficult to get used to.

"Just call me A-Ren."

"Boss Ren..."

"A-Ren! Ren as in the blade of a knife!"

This woman must be an idiot.

Li Ren muttered inwardly.

Ning Qing's smile grew even sweeter, bright yet tinged with shyness, and she obediently called out:

"A-Ren!"

Li Ren smiled faintly, looking somewhat satisfied as he nodded. He raised his glass without drinking and asked again:

"Don't you have anything to say to me?"

"What does A-Ren mean?"

His gaze was burning as he stared at her, his fingers tapping lightly on his knee as if silently questioning her.

His brow twitched slightly, his eyes flashing with unspoken, profound meaning.

Ning Qing reacted for a moment, feeling somewhat bewildered.

Could he be asking about the first time they met? She asked tentatively:

"Does A-Ren mean what happened last time? Last time, although you helped me, you also took advantage of me, so we should... consider it even."

A heartless little vixen!

Li Ren glanced at her sideways, let out a scoff, and said:

"The Xinglong Gang won't be giving you any more trouble from now on. No matter how you look at it, shouldn't you be the one in my debt?"

Ning Qing's eyes flickered slightly. Although she had already guessed this, it was only now confirmed.

Although the Xinglong Gang wasn't a particularly large gang, no one had ever dared to touch them, relying entirely on their connection with the Lin family.

The fact that he could wipe out the Xinglong Gang overnight meant this person's background was not to be underestimated.

"You did that?"

Surely her heart should be blossoming with gratitude for wiping out the Xinglong Gang for her?

With a blank expression, Ning Qing continued to press:

"Are you trying to leverage a favor for repayment? I didn't ask you to wipe out the Xinglong Gang for me. Just who on earth are you? Are you also in the underworld? The Linshengtang? Or the Red Flag Gang?"

Li Ren raised his eyes to look straight at Ning Qing, looking almost amused to the point of anger as he quietly pushed his inner cheek with his tongue.

Playing dumb with me? How many years have I spent playing the fool? Utterly ignorant of the immensity of heaven and earth!

Ha! There are plenty of ways to repay a favor.

"Who I am doesn't matter. I came to see you on serious business."

"Tell me, A-Ren, I'm listening!"

"How much do you make a month here?"

"It varies. Hmm... on the low side, two to three hundred thousand; on the high side, six to seven hundred thousand, I suppose."

Why is this big black bear suddenly interested in my salary? Is he trying to poach me?

Ning Qing spoke casually, leaning back to rest against the sofa, only to feel something poke her in the back.
