Looking back, she saw Li Ren's arm resting on the back of the sofa behind her. Ning Qing quickly sat up straight, awkwardly picked up her wine glass, and took a small sip.

"I'll keep you. One million a month."

Ning Qing, who had just half a sip of wine in her mouth, almost spat it out upon hearing this and forced herself to swallow it down.

"Wh-What?"

"Are your ears broken?"

Li Ren raised an eyebrow slightly. Was he not speaking Country A's language?

Ning Qing was torn between laughter and tears, another man coveting her beauty.

And here she thought it was some serious business; he could actually talk about keeping a mistress as casually as buying groceries, and surprisingly without feeling greasy.

Confirming she hadn't misheard, Ning Qing narrowed her pretty eyes at the man and smiled lightly:

"I don't sell my body, not for any amount of money! A-Ren, is this your first time here? I'm under contract, you know, buying me out doesn't come cheap."

A man like this; whoever gets entangled with him is cursed! Besides, she still had a deep revenge to exact; how could she become some gilded canary!

Ning Qing put down her wine glass, lifted her chin, and put on an expression that brooked no further discussion.

Li Ren let out a soft scoff, slowly stubbed out his cigarette with an expressionless face, a flash of slyness lurking deep within his eyes.

The next second, the arm behind Ning Qing suddenly swept around, and a pair of large hands pinned the back of her neck with the force of a thunderbolt, pushing her face right up to the man's.

Ning Qing was startled by the sudden move, her apricot-shaped eyes wide. At this distance, the tips of their noses were almost touching.

With a mocking expression on his face, Li Ren asked:

"I'm not too familiar with the market rates. Why don't you name a price? I can afford however much you ask!"

The words sounded like a polite negotiation, but the tone and expression sounded entirely like coercion no matter how you listened to it!

"Boss..."

"I said, call me A-Ren. Your memory seems a bit poor?"

Subconsciously resisting, Ning Qing reached out to push him away, only to find that he was like a mountain, unmoving, with a hand as steady as a rock.

"Let go of me... or I'll call someone!"

chapters.title: I have good technique, I won't torture you
chapters.content:
Her tone was firm.

Li Ren showed no intention of letting go; instead, he increased the pressure.

"Go ahead and call! I love hearing a group of people scream in agony!"

As he spoke, his smile grew even more unbridled.

Ning Qing bit her lip in pain, cursing him a million times in her heart.

What on earth does this perverted freak want? Is he trying to force a buyout by buying and selling by force?

Afraid that calling for people now would be useless, those two black-suited bodyguards at the door could clearly take on several people each, since playing hardball wouldn't work, she'd try playing it soft. Ning Qing raised her watery, wide eyes to look at him, softening her voice as she furrowed her brow and murmured:

"A-Ren, it hurts~ Can you let go, please?"

Her tender and soft voice didn't earn her a shred of pity from Li Ren, who said coldly:

"If it hurts, agree to it! Otherwise, it's going to hurt a lot more."

Well, I'll be, he's immune to both soft and hard tactics?

In an attitude of "whatever," Ning Qing stopped struggling and cast her gaze elsewhere.

"Even if you get my body, you won't get my heart."

Li Ren chuckled lightly:

"What a coincidence, all I want is the body."

"I... I won't agree to you!"

Ning Qing's delicate face flushed slightly crimson, her round eyes stubborn yet carrying a hint of anger.

Li Ren nodded approvingly, praising her with a tone of appreciation:

"Spine. Not bad!"

Unfortunately, the appreciative expression lasted for only two seconds before Li Ren's calm face suddenly turned somewhat ruthless.

He slowly pulled an exquisite and sharp dagger from his lower leg. The cold light of the blade flashed past, and the harsh sound of it being drawn made Ning Qing's heart tighten.

In an instant, the atmosphere turned grim.

Ning Qing could never have imagined at this moment what kind of predicament she was about to face! How she regretted being so stubborn with her words right now!

"Wh-What are you going to do?"

Li Ren let out a light hum, pulled her straight into his lap, half-reclining against his knees. His muscular physique and powerful aura were awe-inspiring.

"Let me go, no!"

The bright dagger looked exceptionally dazzling in the dim room. It slid all the way up from her lower leg to her neck, and then slowly came to rest against her fair, slender thigh.

Wherever the tip of the blade passed, the icy chill made Ning Qing shiver.

Li Ren twitched the corner of his mouth, watching Ning Qing's somewhat pale face, a look of morbid excitement surfacing in his eyes.

"Little vixen, quite a spine! Good... I've helped you out a fair bit too. If you can take this knife-stroke, I'll let you go. Fair enough, right?"

Is he going to carve off my flesh?

Ning Qing's heart constricted, and her voice couldn't help but tremble slightly as she said:

"A-Ren, put... put the knife down first, okay?"

"Relax, I have good technique, I won't torture you. I'll just shave off a tiny bit of meat right by the bone, including the fascia, just a little snip and it'll be over. Be a good girl!"

Li Ren's teasing, joking tone made Ning Qing not even dare to blink. She stared fixedly at the tip of the blade, large beads of sweat breaking out on her fair face and trickling down her jawline.

I haven't avenged the Ning family yet; I can't afford to mess up!

A wise person submits to circumstances; I have to find a way to bluff my way through first!

"Wait!"

Li Ren playfully tilted his head, his sharp-angled face slowly closing in on her, his voice magnetic and gentle.

"I haven't even started yet."

"No need! A-Ren! I agree!"

Ning Qing's panicked voice trembled slightly as she squeezed out an ugly smile, staring fixedly at Li Ren for confirmation.

Li Ren lowered his long eyelashes, looking as though he hadn't had his fill of fun yet. He tossed the dagger onto the table and said softly:

"Alright. From now on, you're mine."

As the sentence akin to a death-warrant sounded, Ning Qing bit her lip, smiled awkwardly, and picked up a cigarette for Li Ren.

Li Ren leaned forward to grab the lighter.

Taking advantage of the moment to light the cigarette, Ning Qing hurriedly poured Li Ren another drink, seizing the opportunity to slip in the "soul-dissolving powder" she had meticulously prepared.

Immediately afterward, she poured one for herself as well.

Want to keep me as your canary? You've got the wrong person! Have a nice, long sleep, you perverted big black bear!

"A-Ren, since I'm going to be your woman anyway, why don't we have a drink to celebrate?"

Unsuspectingly, Li Ren took the glass, his eyes full of desire as he watched Ning Qing fawn over him, and downed it in one go.

Ning Qing followed suit and finished hers, her eyes darting over from time to time to confirm that he had swallowed it.

Very good, now just waiting for the drug to take effect!

Ning Qing put down her wine glass, the corners of her mouth curling up unconsciously as the tension on her face dissipated.

"Do you have a lot of things? Do you want someone to help you pack?"

The drug effect should take about five to ten minutes; I'll play along for now.

"Not much, just a little. I'll pack it myself."

Unaware of any abnormality, Li Ren asked flatly:

"Name."

"...Ning Qing."

Li Ren nodded slightly, his thin lips parting:

"Mm. Little vixen, pack up your things; you're leaving with me tonight."

Ning Qing was stunned once again. Little vixen? Didn't I say my name was Ning Qing?

"Tonight?"

"Inconvenient?"

Li Ren's soft words always carried a coercive sense of oppression, and his confirming tone sounded more like compulsion.

Is he in such a rush?

Ning Qing smiled awkwardly, displaying a charming and ingratiating appearance to the fullest.

"Convenient! I couldn't ask for anything better! A-Ren is my savior, after all! How could it be inconvenient?"

His brow furrowed slightly, a ripple of hard-to-detect emotion passing through his eyes as he took a light drag on his cigarette.

She could tell, of course, that the man before her wanted to sleep with her. His intense lust was laid bare, written unashamedly across his face.

Ning Qing's gaze brushed lightly across the man's profile. This physical shell was enough for ordinary women to fall without realizing it at a single glance.

Li Ren glanced at her sideways. Seeing that she was still staring at him in a daze, he raised an eyebrow and asked in a low, husky voice:

"Am I really that good-looking?"

Ning Qing paused for a moment, her smile freezing slightly as she couldn't help but roll her eyes inwardly.

"A-Ren... is the best-looking man I've ever seen!"

Can good looks be eaten as a meal? Can they exact revenge? Can they keep you safe?

Li Ren's handsome lips curved slightly in a shallow smile.

She really was a sucker for looks; just a little dressing up and a shower had her staring straight at him.

His eyes grew increasingly deep, his teasing intent obvious, and his straightforward gaze held no concealment.

"Is that so? Then tonight... I'll leave the lights on, and you can look all you want!"

Ning Qing was beautiful; fair-skinned, good-figured, especially those eyes of hers, clear and bright, right down to her very strands of hair matching his aesthetic.

Although she was wearing cheap, sexy evening wear, had no expensive jewelry, and her makeup and perfume were also a bit cheap, it couldn't hide her bright and stunning charms.

Last time, he had rushed over to the construction site of the Li family's real estate company to deal with a bunch of troublemakers. Right after finishing, Li Ya anxiously sent him off to look for someone. He hadn't even had time to change his clothes before accidentally "helping" this woman who was being chased.

That brief contact had been far too brief; Li Ren wasn't satisfied.

Seeing her this time, aside from her exquisite appearance, he also discovered that she possessed a stubborn and cunningly lively temperament, much like a little vixen, making him want to possess her to the point of addiction.

Hearing his seemingly casual tease, Ning Qing's face flushed slightly crimson, her eyes darting around as she let out two awkward laughs.

When this man started flirting, it was actually somewhat heart-accelerating.

Li Ren took her hand and said, "Let's go."

Seeing him about to stand up, Ning Qing panicked and her eyes widened in shock.

She was still waiting for the drug to take effect and needed to stall for time. She hurriedly pushed him back down.

"Ah? A-Ren, we haven't gotten to know each other yet... what's the rush? Besides, you haven't told me what you do for a living yet!"

A meaningful smile bloomed on Li Ren's face, making him look very "benevolent."

chapters.title: The First Woman He Wanted to Sleep With Properly
chapters.content:
His dark eyes, like a whirlpool, were made even more captivating by the fullness beneath them and the peach-blossom shape of the eye itself, and the slight curve of his lips gave off a dangerous air.

"If I told you all about my affairs, I'm afraid I'd frighten you. Better not ask." Was he some desperate outlaw who killed and robbed, who plundered homes?

Ning Qing seemed to sense the unusual atmosphere and nodded. "All right! If A-Ren doesn't want to say, I won't ask."

"Just think of me... as an ordinary person."

"How could an ordinary person be as good-looking as A-Ren? A-Ren's figure and looks are the finest in the world! How could you be ordinary?"

The smile on Li Ren's face grew clearer. Her mouth was sweet, at least!

"A-Ren, how much will it cost for you to take me away? Boss Xiang won't necessarily let me go, since, after all, I can earn him quite a lot..."

"However much he wants, I can afford it. Don't worry."

He smiled with confidence and elegance, tinged with a wild, untamed air.

"You're that rich? That's not a small sum, so why don't you wait for me to..."

"You're dragging your feet with me here. Are you going to go back on it?"

Li Ren's gaze cooled, mixed with scrutiny, and Ning Qing suddenly shivered.

Why did it feel as though he could see right through her?

It had been so long. The drug should have taken effect by now, so why was he still acting as if nothing were wrong?

Was it because he was so big that the drug worked more slowly?

If this conversation went on, it would be the death of her... She should have used a double dose!

Full of regret, Ning Qing hurriedly took his hand with feigned intimacy and gently rubbed it, looking like an obedient, eager little student.

"Of course not! I just want to know you better... A-Ren, which number am I among the women you've kept?"

His hand was large and thick, with long fingers and clear knuckles, and thick calluses from fists and blades on the back and the palm that were startling even to touch.

Sure enough, he was someone who often fought and killed. She would have to handle him carefully to get away safely!

Li Ren pressed his lips together and hesitated for one second before saying:

"The first."

"Then I'm honored to be the first woman A-Ren has liked."

Li Ren gave a soft laugh.

Liked? Heh... That didn't quite count.

"To be precise, the first woman I wanted to sleep with properly!"

Ning Qing cursed inwardly, her throat bobbing, the expression on her face teetering on the edge of collapse.

Sure enough, a man ruled by his lower half!

"I would never have guessed A-Ren was such a simple man? I thought you had been with countless women..."

Ning Qing had barely managed to steady herself, and never expected that these few casual words would nearly cost her everything! Li Ren's brows drew together without his noticing. Countless women, yes, but they had either been prey bound to a rope and swaying at the edge, or assassins who had delivered themselves to his door, and their ends...

As for the word "simple," how should he take it?

"A-Ren, aren't you the least bit curious about me? Don't you need to know who I am?"

"Whoever you are makes no difference to me."

"..."

What arrogance.

The corner of Ning Qing's mouth twitched slightly, and she awkwardly picked up her glass and took a sip. Her clear eyes were like lake water, as if without a single impurity, and her pretty little mouth pouted slightly, a look of confusion in her eyes that tugged at Li Ren's heart.

His handsome face gave nothing away, though a ripple passed through his thick brows as he slowly put out his cigarette.

This little fox, so eager to seduce me.

The next second, a broad hand seized Ning Qing's arm and pulled, and the two were pressed together without a gap.

He lowered his eyes, tilting his head slightly, and looked at the little woman before him.

"Since you're in such a hurry, it's not impossible!"

"What? R-right now?"

What was going on? What had she done?

"Don't worry. My men are watching the door. Anyone who dares look will have his eyes gouged out!"

"I don't..."

Before Ning Qing could resist, her head was already gripped by one large hand, and Li Ren's sensual, thin lips came down on hers.

The sudden kiss was like a storm, catching her completely off guard. It was deep and overwhelming, and Ning Qing felt her breath and her thoughts being taken from her, leaving her no choice but to let him do as he pleased.

Resistance was futile.

Damn it! I don't believe my Ning family's secret medicine can fail!

"Is there such a rush? Wouldn't tonight, in bed... be better?"

"Not really. I'm buying you for a year, twelve million, starting now."

"...Even this has to be mutual!"

"With me, if I'm willing, you'd better be willing!"

Li Ren's breathing was a little heavy, and the curve of his lips was very alluring.

"Also, I'll tell you now, don't try to refuse. I don't like disobedient people! Otherwise... watch your life!"

His hand rested at her neck, as if a little pressure could snap it.

What kind of tyrannical terms were these? Only a madwoman would agree to them!

A simple kiss no longer satisfied him.

One large hand slipped in beneath her thin skirt, and on her white shoulders and neck he had already left several marks of varying depth, somewhere between bites and nibbles.

"Ah! Mm..."

Just as Ning Qing was in so much pain that she almost wanted to break free, the tense force at her waist unexpectedly slackened a little.

Li Ren frowned slightly, a haze in his eyes, and raised a hand to touch his temple, his gaze fixed fiercely on Ning Qing.

That little fox... dared to drug him?

The corner of Ning Qing's mouth lifted slightly in a sly, barely noticeable smile, and she asked with feigned concern:

"...A-Ren, what's wrong? A-Ren?"

Li Ren only felt his head spin, as though the whole world were whirling and tilting, and in the next instant his eyelids closed heavily and he fell into darkness.

Ning Qing called him a couple more times, carefully, and finally let out a breath of relief. In revenge, she gave his face a few light slaps.

"Big black bear, that's the Ning family's secret medicine. You can't buy it on any ordinary day!"

With that, she stood up and poured the remaining two bottles of red wine into the toilet in the private room.

She straightened her clothes and her expression, and once she was sure she looked fine, she walked out of the room.

Jin Shui and Yin Shui, leaning against the wall, quickly stood up straight when they saw Ning Qing come out, and carefully glanced inside.

"Miss Ning, why did you come out alone?"

"Mm! Your boss seems to be in a bad mood. He drank over two bottles and fell asleep. You'd better take him back quickly."

"Fell asleep?"

Jin Shui and Yin Shui looked at each other as if they couldn't believe it.

Asleep? Had Sir's insomnia been cured?

"Yes, would I lie to you? When you're in a bad mood you get drunk easily! Or you can go look for yourselves. I'm off work."

With that, Ning Qing slipped away, leaving a carefree figure behind.

Of course she did not know what disaster this move would bring to her in the near future!

---

The next afternoon, Li Ren woke up in bed in his hillside villa.

He rubbed his dizzy forehead, and a trace of menace surfaced in his bold, untamed eyes.

Li Ren's ink-black hair fell softly across his forehead, his exquisite face expressionless, and the corners of his cold, haughty lips curled in a scornful smile.

That little fox. I underestimated you!

chapters.title: If I Come Back Alive, You'll Regret It!
chapters.content:
He lowered his eyes and looked at his hand, and in his mind, without his meaning it to, rose the scene of Ning Qing gripping his hand the night before.

That little hand was fair and delicate, soft as smooth silk. His thumb gently rubbed the spot she had touched, as if he could still savor her warmth.

Suddenly the phone rang. It was Li Zhili.

The look in Li Ren's eyes changed at once from clear to cloudy, becoming sharp.

"It's me."

"A-Ren! About that land in Nanlin, don't leave it to Munan. You go and settle that Ma Ziqiang yourself, and get him to sign the contract before you make a move! I'll have my secretary send you the materials later. Don't reveal your identity!"

"Understood."

After those two brief sentences, Li Ren calmly hung up, cold killing intent flooding his eyes.

Ren means blade.

He was the Li family's blade.

His eyes cold, Li Ren put on loose, comfortable clothes and, out of habit, put on a strand of prayer beads from his bedside.

He hadn't slept so well in a long time. Li Ren twisted his neck and called Jin Shui in.

"Take Lu Min. We're going to work."

"Yes, Sir! But... isn't it Death Song's A-Qi's turn this time? Why are you sending Old Six?"

"There's an order for long blades in Southeast Asia, and Langyue is handling it. Let A-Qi deal with that first."

"Yes!"

Death Song was an organization Li Ren had carefully built over many years, and everyone in it was a hand-picked elite killer with their own skills.

It would not be wrong to call them revenge machines, and among certain gangs and organizations they were feared at the mere mention of their name.

Besides being good at their jobs, the only thing that counted was loyalty. When there was no work, they were in charge of protecting Li Ren's safety.

Li Ren looked at the strand of prayer beads on his wrist, engraved with the character for "endure," and a haze covered his eyes.

He ate a little something, and then it suddenly occurred to him:

What had that little fox been rambling on about before?

Never mind... If I come back alive, you'll regret it!

---

Two days later.

He dealt with Ma Ziqiang and his gang with swift efficiency and then rested for a day.

That day, after the family doctor changed the dressings on Li Ren's wounds, Li Ren put on his clothes, walked out onto the terrace, leaned back against the glass looking at his phone, and lit a cigarette, his hand unconsciously scrolling to that number.

Ning Qing's perfect face rose before his eyes.

It made him press his lips together.

I haven't settled accounts with you yet, little fox!

As he was thinking, the phone suddenly rang.

Seeing the caller, an odd look rose in Li Ren's eyes, and then he frowned.

Guan Jinpeng.

One of Li Ren's few friends.

Over the phone, Guan Jinpeng's bright, enthusiastic voice came through:

"Brother Ren! Did you miss me? I'm back in the country! Won't you throw me a welcome party?"

"You left without a word last time. You still dare come back?"

"You still remember that? I just introduced you to a blind date, and you got that angry? Too petty... Never mind that. Holding grudges makes you old, Brother Ren! I expect to arrive tomorrow, and tomorrow night I'm putting together a gathering at a nightclub. Come and play!"

Li Ren lit a cigarette, his tone flat.

"I don't like places like that."

"You're still going out to play, aren't you afraid that heartless father of yours will arrange an ugly wife for you? Besides, this is my welcome-home party, and you're my best big brother! If you don't come, we're no longer brothers!"

Li Ren rolled his eyes irritably, full of impatience.

The same old trick again!

"I'm not going! What's the point of a noisy place like..."

"Brother Ren! If you do this, I'll be heartbroken. I'll send you the address. Hanging up!"

Li Ren's words were cut off. He wasn't being given the chance to refuse.

Guan Jinpeng, having hung up, smiled smugly and thought to himself:

You stubborn oyster, this time I have no choice. I owe the Lin family a favor, so I can only help that Lin Yamei get a meeting with you!

---

That evening, the underground garage of Baihui Club.

Lin Yamei, holding her phone, waited anxiously.

She sat uneasily by the elevator, glancing at her phone from time to time.

Time ticked by minute after minute, and finally, a message came in.

[He has agreed to come. Wait near the garage elevator. When it's over, I'll bring him down. Whether you can seize the chance is up to you.]

Lin Yamei bit her lip and replied:

[Okay, thank you, Young Master Guan!]

Biting her lip lightly, uneasy in her heart, she also sent a message to her father and mother in the car to let them know.

Her parents hurried out of the car, trembling. The stock of their Lin Corporation had recently fallen to a dismal state, and the company's projects had all been halted. They knew that whatever happened, they had to achieve their goal today! The Lin Corporation could not be allowed to be destroyed!

"Little Mei, when you see Young Master Li, don't put on airs! Even if you have to beg, beg him to spare the Lin Corporation!"

"I know, Dad..."

Lin's father and mother, a couple who were usually overbearing, now stood at the elevator with Lin Yamei, a trace of servility in their expressions.

If Li Ren refused to let the Lin Corporation go today, in three to five days the business they had built with decades of hard work would probably be declared bankrupt.

Lin Yamei's eyes moved as she thought of a plan, and she asked tentatively:

"Dad, since he's willing to come to a place like this, doesn't that mean he isn't uninterested in women? I think those rumors may not be true. A grown man, maybe he..."

Before she finished, her father glared at her and said sternly:

"Don't even think about it! I've heard the Li family's young master stays away from women, and that he has bipolar disorder and is a psychopath, moody and very strange! Don't you dare be clever! You can't even touch someone like that! Are you that short of money? Your life matters!"

Lin Yamei was so frightened her face went pale, and she shut her mouth at once.

Lin's mother couldn't stop complaining:

"The Li family is bullying us too much. Little Mei only talked back a few times, so why should our Lin Corporation go bankrupt for it! So vicious..."

"Shut your mouth! Unlucky woman!"

Lin's father barked sternly, speechless at the mother and daughter, his slightly trembling finger pointing at her forehead:

"What kind of people are the Li family? They have power that reaches the sky!"

"But... but they still can't bully people like this! Besides, it was our people who got beaten worse! He hasn't even..."

Lin's father nearly fainted from rage, and laughed from sheer anger.

"Ha! Hit him? If we had hit him, would we still have a chance to come and beg? Li Zhili, the head of the Li family, is vicious beyond measure. I saw with my own eyes how he dealt with the Ma family! Didn't you see the news? They called it an accident... they were burned to charcoal!

The Li family was competing with the Ma family for a project. Anyone with eyes could see the Li family did it.

Now Little Mei has offended his only son. This young master Li is usually low-key and doesn't show his hand, but after all he is Li Zhili's son! Even if he killed all of us today, no one would dare expose it!"

This time Lin's mother and Lin Yamei were truly afraid and did not dare say another word.

---

Meanwhile, Ning Qing was working listlessly. Her customer that day was a pot-bellied nouveau riche man who kept trying little tricks on her.

Fortunately Ning Qing was used to scenes like this and handled it with ease. She did not know that news that would catch her completely off guard was about to arrive.

chapters.title: Want to Play a Game with Me?
chapters.content:
Meanwhile, although Li Ren was at the club, he had no interest in the crowd of women. He drank by himself, leaning against the sofa with a hint of boredom.

Several women threw their most alluring glances at him, practically ready to strip bare, yet they couldn't even catch a single glance from him.

Who on earth was this top-tier, handsome wealthy patron, able to make Young Master Guan so eagerly wait on him?

Everyone speculated wildly, but Li Ren only found it noisy.

With a cigarette in one hand and his phone in the other, he sent a text message.

[Little fox, I'll give you one more chance. Would you rather stay in a club like this serving different men every day, or come with me?]

Ning Qing was in the middle of her shift when she saw the message, her heart suddenly tightening.

Should I pretend I didn't see it?

No, he already found my phone number...

I'll stall him first and figure something out later!

[A-Ren! Give me some time to think about it, okay? I promise you, I will think it over carefully!]

Li Ren pouted as he thought for a moment, then hooked the corner of his lips into a smile.

Trying to string me along?

He elegantly stubbed out his cigarette, stood up, and said to Guan Jinpeng,

"I'm leaving!"

"Huh? Brother Ren? Leaving just like that? What's going on, you just got here! Do you not like this woman?"

"I have things to do."

With those words, Li Ren picked up his suit jacket, and under the watchful eyes of everyone, his tall figure strode out the door coolly.

The exact moment Li Ren stepped out, Guan Jinpeng hurried to follow, an intimate smile plastered across his face.

Li Ren turned his head and shot him a faint glance.

"Your welcome party, and you're just leaving like this?"

"It's just a welcome party, how could it compare to you, Brother Ren? I'll see you out!"

Guan Jinpeng smiled and deliberately led Li Ren toward the elevator where Lin Yamei was waiting.

Following closely behind Li Ren, the two walked toward the elevator together.

Seeing that he was in a good mood, Guan Jinpeng's eyes rolled as he curiously asked,

"Brother Ren, why are you so distracted? With so many beauties today, not even a single one caught your eye?"

"Beauties? What beauties?"

Guan Jinpeng widened his eyes in astonishment.

"Brother Ren! Is something wrong with your eyes? I called over a dozen women today, from rookie models to actresses! You..."

Li Ren almost laughed out loud, shook his head, and said,

"They smell like dust. Looking at them gives me no desire."

"......Have you ever had desire? You'll only know if you try! Aren't you still a..."

"A what?"

As soon as those words came out, Guan Jinpeng's excitement was instantly crushed, knowing full well what the consequences would be if he kept talking.

"Nothing!"

Li Ren pulled back his gaze and strode forward.

Guan Jinpeng, standing at one meter seventy-five, quickly hurried after him.

"Brother Ren, um... you've been staring at your phone all day, who are you texting?"

Just as he was speaking, the figures of the three members of the Lin family came into view.

Li Ren calmly looked at them, though the expression on his face was indescribable.

He had already arranged for Yin Shui to handle things earlier; estimating the timeline, the Lin Corporation should be on the verge of bankruptcy by now, and yet they still had the mood to come out and play?

He glanced at Guan Jinpeng, as if he had already seen through their collusion.

Realizing he couldn't hide it, Guan Jinpeng whispered by Li Ren's side,

"Brother Ren, don't blame me. The Guan family owes a favor to the Lin family, so I'm helping them get a meeting with you. Just do me a favor this once, and you can deal with them however you like..."

Li Ren let out a soft scoff.

"Fine, I'll give you this face."

Father Lin walked up with a bowed, respectful posture and spoke first:

"Young Master Li, we've been waiting here for a long time. It was my stupid daughter who was blind and offended you before. We're here to beg for your forgiveness! Please raise your hand and let us off this once!"

"Young Master Li, Xiaomei really didn't mean it. She was just... just straightforward! She can't stand the behavior of those cheap women, which is why she did those things."

Mother Lin chimed in as well, while Lin Yamei nervously twisted her fingers, stealing cautious glances at him from time to time.

Hearing Mother Lin's words, Li Ren's expression sank instantly.

He raised an eyebrow, crossed his arms, and asked in a low, scrutinizing voice,

"Cheap women?"

"Yeah! She works in a place like this, isn't she just that? Xiaomei, don't you think so?"

Mother Lin didn't notice Li Ren's displeased expression and nudged Lin Yamei with her elbow.

Lin Yamei hurriedly nodded and plucked up the courage to say,

"Y-yes! That Ning Qing... she's just an arrogant and bitchy person. Who knows how many men she's slept with before, she's filthy! I really only wanted to deal with her that day because of some old grudges, who knew she was so cunning and managed to escape... If I had known you were from the Li family, I wouldn't have dared to say those things even if I had ten lives!"

Li Ren, who had already felt displeased upon seeing them, couldn't help but laugh out loud in anger upon hearing this.

"Filthy?"

Every single word coming out of their mouths was something he disliked.

That little fox, he had 'personally' verified her himself.

Guan Jinpeng, watching from the side, cursed inwardly at this expression: Oh no!

A hint of a smile flashed in Li Ren's eyes as he casually raised a hand to wave at Jin Shui waiting inside the car, signaling him to get out.

Afterward, with a cool and graceful posture, he got into the car.

Through the car window, Li Ren tilted his head to look at the three of them, a bizarre excitement welling up in his dark eyes:

"Want me to let the Lin family off? No problem, play a game with me, 'Truth or Dare'!"

"T-Truth or... Dare?"

The three of them froze, looking at each other in bewilderment.

Li Ren chuckled lightly, started the sports car, his eyes growing increasingly arrogant.

"Stand still and don't move, and I'll let the Lin family go!"

Without waiting for them to react, Li Ren pressed down on the gas pedal without a moment's hesitation.

The roar of the sports car echoed as the three members of the Lin family stood frozen in place, watching the priceless sports car speed straight toward them.

"Ah!"

"No, don't!"

"Young Master Li! No!"

Piercing screams erupted from the mouths of the three Lin family members.

The moment the car charged toward them, as the blinding glare of the headlights closed in, they snapped back to reality. Their bodies reacted before their minds could process it, and they scrambled away to both sides in panic.

Guan Jinpeng swallowed hard, completely frozen in place with terror.

Brother Ren is still just as crazy, the Lin family didn't commit crimes punishable by death!

Seeing them scramble away in terror, Li Ren's eyes lit up with even more amusement, flashing with an unusual brilliance.

"This is way more fun than the game upstairs!"

The corners of his mouth curled up as he burst into hearty laughter, as if he were genuinely enjoying a thrilling game.

The three members of the Lin family scrambled away in a panic; Mother Lin had already scraped her knee, fleeing in utter disgrace.

"Hiding? The hawk is coming!"

With those words, he slammed on the gas pedal again, and the car's speed instantly skyrocketed.

This thrilling scene played out two or three times. The three members of the Lin family were already paralyzed with terror, collapsing to the ground and kneeling helplessly as they pleaded:

"Young Master Li! We were wrong! We were truly wrong, please forgive us!"

"Please let us go! We're begging you!"

"Young Master Li, I won't do it again, I really will never dare again! There will absolutely not be a next time!"

Seeing them in this state inexplicably aroused Li Ren's disgust. He lazily remarked,

"Not only spineless, but also insincere. This doesn't look much like an apology."

Lin Yamei cried as she shouted,

"Young Master Li, what kind of sincerity do you want? Do you really want us to die?!"

chapters.title: Will You Do Anything?
chapters.content:
Li Ren let out a soft scoff.

"Idiots!"

Then, he abruptly turned the steering wheel, his headlights flashing as he drove straight toward Lin Yamei.

Lin Yamei watched with her own eyes as the car closed in, her heart leaping into her throat.

The moment the vehicle was about to hit her, she slammed her eyes shut and used every ounce of strength in her body to emit a shrill plea:

"Young Master Li! As long as you're willing to let us go! Whatever you make me do, I'm willing!"

As soon as those words left her mouth, the tires screeched harshly against the concrete.

The sports car stopped a mere few inches away from Lin Yamei.

With lingering fear, Lin Yamei opened her eyes, looking with a glimmer of joy at the man stepping out of the sports car.

Ruthless and merciless as Li Ren was, he possessed supreme status! If she could get Li Ren to spare her family, it wouldn't hurt to sleep with this madman!

Li Ren leaned out to eye her:

"Will you do anything?"

He gracefully stepped out of the car, lazily leaning against the body of the vehicle, and lit a cigarette as he watched Lin Yamei with keen interest.

Father Lin and Mother Lin exchanged glances upon seeing this, their eyes carrying a trace of joy as well.

Could it be that this Li Ren had actually taken a fancy to their daughter?

Thinking she had guessed correctly, Lin Yamei tried her best to put on an alluring expression and said,

"Yes! As long as Young Master says it, no matter what... I am willing to do it!"

"That's a bit more sincere."

Li Ren hooked his lips into a faint smile, but his next frigid words completely shattered Lin Yamei's fantasies.

"Alright, I'll give you a chance! No matter what method you use, as long as you can win her forgiveness, I can let the Lin family off. Otherwise, next time..."

Li Ren paused, raised a hand to pat his car hood, and added,

"It won't be this simple!"

Hearing this, Lin Yamei's face turned abruptly pale.

She had originally thought that Li Ren stopped the car because he had actually taken a fancy to her.

Never did she expect! It was for that Ning Qing again!

"What? Unwilling?"

Li Ren's gaze fell upon the silent Lin Yamei. His eyes were as cold as ice, and as he raised them slightly, they exuded an oppressive pressure.

Feeling this chill, Father and Mother Lin trembled involuntarily all over.

They hurriedly rushed to Lin Yamei's side and gave her an anxious push, signaling her to reply.

Recovering her senses, Lin Yamei took a deep breath, clenched her teeth, and agreed.

"Yes! I will definitely win Ning Qing's forgiveness..."

Seeing her agree, Li Ren nodded, then tossed his keys to Jin Shui.

This time, you should finally be grateful to me.

Still can't take down a little fox like you?

"Very well, let's go."

"Yes!"

Watching the tail lights of the sports car gradually disappear, Lin Yamei tightly clenched her back teeth in resentment, her eyes filled with bitter hatred.

---

The next evening.

Just as Ning Qing finished applying her exquisite makeup, she was hurriedly dragged into a private booth by the manager.

Expecting to meet a familiar old regular customer, she never imagined it would be Lin Yamei.

Watching Lin Yamei order every single drink on the menu, Ning Qing felt bewildered and asked with a frown,

"What are you doing? Are you trying to make me drink all of these?"

There were over twenty bottles of alcohol here. If she really made her drink all of them, she'd either be dead or hospitalized.

"No, no, no!"

Lin Yamei hastily stood up and walked a few steps toward Ning Qing, her face completely devoid of the arrogance and domineering attitude she had shown days prior.

Yet the more she acted like this, the more vigilant Ning Qing felt inside.

"What does Miss Lin mean by this? Could it be that you're buying these drinks to apologize to me?"

Ning Qing scoffed as she said those words, feeling somewhat absurd herself.

Just as Ning Qing was thinking this, Lin Yamei suddenly spoke up.

"Ning Qing! It was my fault before, I shouldn't have sent people to bully you over such a trivial matter! I already know I was wrong. I bought all these drinks today, and they all count toward your commission as my apology. Can you please forgive me?"

Lin Yamei's words completely baffled Ning Qing. She didn't take Lin Yamei for someone who would willingly apologize.

Seeing that Ning Qing remained silent, Lin Yamei quickly poured a glass of wine, handed it to Ning Qing, and said,

"I know that if I just gave you money, you definitely wouldn't accept it, so I came up with this method. Ning Qing, drink this glass of wine, consider it your forgiveness for me, okay?"

Ning Qing gave her a deep look, then suddenly hooked her lips into a smile.

"Miss Lin, your stunt here; I honestly don't get it."

Hearing this, Lin Yamei clenched her back teeth, forcing a strained smile on her face.

"Ning Qing, it's all my fault. I'll never cause trouble for you again. I'm apologizing sincerely, won't you forgive me?"

"You're apologizing to me? Did I hear that right? Why?"

"I... I've thought it through. I shouldn't have slandered you, I was just muddle-headed and..."

"Enough! Your hypocritical act makes me sick! Miss Lin, what scheme are you pulling this time? Do you really think I'd believe you're here to apologize? When you came the other day, you clearly came prepared just to target me! Wanting to take nude photos? Wanting to have me gang-raped? Truly vicious enough! Why are you acting like this now?"

Ning Qing slammed her glass onto the table with a thud, a cold expression surfacing on her bright face.

"You... Ning Qing, I've realized my mistakes."

Looking at Lin Yamei's unnatural, lowered posture, Ning Qing let out a cold scoff.

"We've reached this point, what's the point of pretending anymore! Miss Lin, you slandered the Ning family that day, said so many vicious things, and even tried to violate me. If I hadn't managed to escape by luck, I wouldn't even have the fortune to listen to your fake sincerity now!"

Did she really take me for a saint? Forgive you just because of a few words of apology?

That day was so perilous; if she hadn't bumped into that man, she would have been ruined long ago!

Hearing this, Lin Yamei's body shuddered instantly, her expression nearly collapsing as she suppressed her anger and said,

"So what if it's fake sincerity? At least I'm apologizing! This lineup and the money are more than enough, are you still refusing to forgive me? Are you ungrateful?!"

Ning Qing lowered her eyes to ponder for a moment, staring straight into Lin Yamei's somewhat anxious eyes.

"Who forced you? This isn't your style at all."

Lin Yamei bit her lip and resentfully averted her gaze elsewhere.

Jin Shui had explicitly warned her not to let Miss Ning know the identity of Young Master Li.

This instinctive reaction, in Ning Qing's eyes, was equivalent to giving her a silent answer.

Ning Qing already understood. Someone must have threatened Lin Yamei; otherwise, given Lin Yamei's personality, she would probably be wishing she could kill her right now, let alone take the initiative to apologize.

Who could it be?

Her second uncle or her younger aunt would never help her. Could it be the Shang family? Impossible, she had never crossed paths with them at all.

Thinking of this, Ning Qing said coldly,

"Fine. Since you won't say, your apology; I don't accept it! And you'd better not come looking for me in the future, because I don't want to see you!"

With that, Ning Qing pulled open the door of the private room without looking back and walked out, leaving Lin Yamei with a cool yet desperate figure.

chapters.title: You Owe Her Some Appreciation by Now!
chapters.content:
Lin Yamei sat there in a daze, glaring viciously in the direction the other woman had left, biting her lower lip in sheer resentment.

"Bitch! I'm going to kill you!"

It looked like Ning Qing was never going to forgive her. How on earth was she supposed to explain this to the young master of the Li family?

Not long after Ning Qing walked out, Lin Yamei received a call from Li Ren. Scared half to death and turning somewhat pale, she let the phone ring for a long time before finally answering:

"Young Master Li."

"How did things go?"

A lazy voice sounded from the other end of the line. Although the tone was casual, it pressed down on Lin Yamei with a heavy, suffocating pressure, as if an invisible mountain were crushing her chest, making it hard to breathe.

Hearing Lin Yamei hesitate to answer, the voice on the other end grew even colder and darker.

"What? It didn't go well?"

Clutching her phone in fright, she answered instinctively:

"Ning Qing, Ning Qing forgave me! I bought every single kind of drink she had, put them all on her tab, and apologized to her sincerely, begging for her forgiveness. She has... stopped holding a grudge!"

Hearing this, Li Ren's alluring lips curved upward slightly.

It seemed that little vixen was quite the saint, huh?

This time, you really owe her some appreciation!

Then, he replied indifferently:

"Fine, I'll let you off for now."

The moment the words fell, the click of the call hanging up echoed through the phone.

Li Ren twirled a short dagger in his hand, a faint smile floating on his lips.

Listening to the dial tone on her phone, Lin Yamei slumped heavily to the ground as if all the air had been let out of her body.

Staring blankly at her phone, she muttered under her breath:

"No! I can't let it go on like this."

That Li Ren was clearly interested in Ning Qing; she could never let him find out the truth.

Yet, as long as Ning Qing was around, the truth would come out sooner or later...

If Li Ren found out she had lied to him by then, everything the Lin family owned would be finished!

She had to make Ning Qing disappear completely!

At this thought, a flash of ruthlessness crossed Lin Yamei's eyes.

Having made up her mind, Lin Yamei took out her phone and dialed a number.

"Lu Xiao, do me a favor."

"Miss Lin, what kind of favor? I've been super busy lately and I'm running short on cash!"

Hearing the probing remark over the phone, Lin Yamei laughed out of anger.

"Isn't work delivering itself right to you now? Help me frame someone, kick her out of Gilded Club, and a few days from now, when she has nowhere left to turn, make her disappear cleanly. Three million once it's done, and it's all yours!"

At the mention of money, Lu Xiao, a compulsive gambler, agreed without the slightest hesitation.

"Three million? Sure, no problem! Tell me, who are we getting rid of?"

Lin Yamei smiled smugly and laid out her plan to him.

After hanging up the phone, she took a slow sip of her drink.

Lu Xiao alone wasn't reliable enough. To ensure success, she needed someone else's help to make it foolproof...

---

At night.

Ning Qing had just finished a shift, feeling a little light-headed from drinking, and was just about to head off to rest when Mamasan Lily suddenly popped out from nowhere.

"Ning Qing! Come with me. A boss specifically asked to see you tonight. You've got an extension!"

"Specifically asked?"

Could it be Li Ren again? Didn't he promise to let her think about it?

"Let's go! Don't you want to make money? Rest assured~ this client doesn't require going out!"

Boss Xiang had given instructions before: guests who wanted hostesses to go out with them were not allowed to be given to Ning Qing. She remembered that clearly.

Ignoring her stunned silence, Mamasan led Ning Qing straight toward a private room.

Entering the room, they found a shifty-eyed man sitting on the sofa, accompanied by several other women.

Among them was Ling Xiahe, who was sitting on the man's lap with a triumphant smile plastered across her face. When her gaze fell on Ning Qing as she walked in, that triumph became even more obvious.

Ning Qing glanced at her. That look... why did it feel so strange?

With no time to overthink, Ning Qing walked over with a smile and sat down beside the man.

"Big brother, my name is Ning Qing."

Lu Xiao lit a cigarette, sizing Ning Qing up with keen interest.

This gig wasn't bad at all. Lin Yamei was reliable for once.

It was just a pity, such a gorgeous beauty... in a few days, he would have to finish her off with his own hands!

"You're the top hostess here? You certainly look the part, worth ten thousand per visit! Look here, big brother will treat you well today, just drink this whole bottle of wine on the table, and the one hundred thousand yuan in this card is yours!"

With that, Lu Xiao tossed a preloaded blank card onto the table.

Looking at the card, Ning Qing's charming expression faltered as she hesitated for a moment internally.

Screw it! The worst that could happen is a stomachache all night, but this is one hundred thousand we're talking about!

"Alright, since big brother is in the mood, I'll finish this bottle for you today and make sure I don't ruin your fun!"

With those words, Ning Qing let out a breath and gracefully picked up a bottle of wine from the table, preparing to pour it straight down her throat.

However, just as she was about to drink, Ling Xiahe suddenly lunged forward past her, swinging her leg out and kicking the arm holding the wine bottle.

Ning Qing's hand jerked, the bottle slipped, and the wine splashed everywhere.

In-your-face enough to be completely deliberate.

Ling Xiahe threw up her hands with an innocent, not-my-problem look.

"Why are you looking at me? I didn't touch you! Looked to me like you just didn't want to drink and did it on purpose!"

Before Ning Qing could question her, Lu Xiao started throwing a tantrum:

"Hey! Beauty, what's the meaning of this? You don't want to drink, so you pull this stunt on me? This stuff costs tens of thousands a bottle, and you just went and spilled it like that?"

Ling Xiahe chimed in, adding fuel to the fire:

"Ning Qing, if you didn't want to drink, you should've just said so! Why put on an act like this? You've gone and wasted such good wine for nothing. You can't blame big brother for being mad; you're the one who went too far!"

Ning Qing could already tell this was Ling Xiahe deliberately targeting her, and a chill flashed in her eyes.

"Big brother, I'm sorry. Let me buy you another bottle, alright?"

Ling Xiahe nudged his arm and shot him a look. Suddenly, Lu Xiao stood up in a fit of rage, towering over Ning Qing.

"Don't change the subject! Are you looking down on me..."

Seeing this, the Mamasan rushed over and pulled Ning Qing up.

"Oh my, Boss! Be the bigger person, why argue with a little girl? This bottle won't go on your tab, I'll have another one brought up right away! You girls, hurry up and clean this up!"

With that, Mamasan pushed Lu Xiao back onto the sofa, soothing him with sweet words.

The other women scurried around to clean up the private room.

Seeing this, Ning Qing shot Ling Xiahe a cold glare and stood up to help as well.

Halfway through the cleanup, a voice suddenly rang out.

"Wait! Nobody move! Where did the jade Buddha I left on the table go?"

Lu Xiao suddenly shouted. Everyone looked over to see him glaring furiously at Ning Qing.

"Did you take it?! Speak!"

"Jade Buddha? What jade Buddha?"

Ning Qing looked completely baffled. What was going on now?

Lu Xiao rushed forward and grabbed Ning Qing by the wrist.

"You bitch! You have the nerve to call yourself the top hostess here? Looks like you're more of a common thief! Who else could it be if not you? We've been hanging out here for ages without any issues, so how come things go missing the moment you show up?"

chapters.title: Let's See How You Do Business After This!
chapters.content:
"Let go of me! I didn't see anything of the sort!"

Ning Qing frowned and jerked her arm free from his grip.

Lu Xiao was growing anxious. That jade piece was worth way more than three million! He had no idea this was a staged play arranged separately by Lin Yamei and Ling Xiahe.

He pointed straight at Ning Qing and cursed loudly:

"I'm telling you, that jade piece of mine is worth over a hundred million! It's imperial green, extremely rare, give it back right now!"

"Mister, are you mistaken? I didn't see any jade Buddha when I came in. How could I have taken your things?"

Ning Qing spoke with a sense of absurdity, a hint of laughing-in-anger at the bottom of her eyes.

Seeing this, Ling Xiahe walked over smoothly, draping both hands over Lu Xiao's shoulders.

"Big brother, Ning Qing brought her handbag in with her. Who knows, the thing might be right inside it. Just take a look and we'll know!"

As soon as those words dropped, everyone turned to look at Ning Qing simultaneously.

"What right do you have to check my bag? Ling Xiahe? Where's your proof?"

Ling Xiahe let out a sneer.

"Proof or not, we'll know once we look! What, scared?"

"Scared? Ha! Let me ask you, if it's not in there, will you kneel and apologize?"

"Fine! If I've wronged you, I'll kneel and apologize to you!"

She even exchanged a glance with Lu Xiao as she spoke.

Looking at Ling Xiahe's confident expression, Ning Qing's heart skipped a beat, suddenly struck by a bad premonition.

As if finally catching on to Ling Xiahe's cue, Lu Xiao smiled darkly and chimed in:

"That's right, if you've got nothing to hide, what are you afraid of? Let's take a look!"

With that, he snatched Ning Qing's handbag right off her and dumped it upside down onto the sofa.

Her lipstick and cosmetics tumbled out, and tumbling out right along with them was a piece of emerald-green jade Buddha.

When Ning Qing's gaze landed on that jade Buddha, she knew deep down something was wrong.

Ling Xiahe had been so dead certain; there was definitely foul play afoot!

She slowly raised her head, her gaze icy as she swept it across everyone in the private room.

A cold smile crossed Ning Qing's heart. Such a sordid trick; it was highly likely another masterpiece of hers!

Still, Ling Xiahe alone wouldn't have had the guts! Someone behind the scenes must be ordering her around.

Lu Xiao picked up the jade Buddha and slammed his palm down heavily onto the coffee table.

"Well, well! It really was you, you thieving bitch! What do you have to say for yourself now? Someone with such sticky fingers has the nerve to work in such an upscale club?"

He turned back to Mamasan.

"Get your boss in here right this second! If you don't give me a satisfactory explanation today, none of you are leaving this place!"

Mamasan was momentarily stunned. How could Ning Qing possibly steal anything?

Realizing instantly that things had gone horribly wrong, she hurried off to fetch Xiang Jinsheng.

A moment later, Xiang Jinsheng arrived in the private room. Having already been briefed on the general situation on his way over, he saw Lu Xiao glaring coldly and winding up to slap Ning Qing across the face, so he rushed forward and intervened:

"Mister! Don't hit her! Let's talk things through!"

He couldn't let Ning Qing get hurt. If Young Master Li asked about this later, selling him off wouldn't be enough to pay for the damage!

Lu Xiao pulled back his hand, sat down in a rage, and shouted arrogantly:

"Harmony brings wealth? The hostesses at your place are stealing right out of my pockets! And you still have the face to tell me about harmony bringing wealth? This jade is worth over a hundred million. You could sell every woman in this room and still not cover it!"

Xiang Jinsheng glanced at Ning Qing, who was standing quietly with a cold expression, then turned back to Lu Xiao.

"Boss Lu, was it? Ning Qing has been a senior worker here for years, she has no reason to pull a stunt like this. Could there be some kind of misunderstanding?"

"Misunderstanding? What kind of misunderstanding could there possibly be? The item was fished right out of her bag! If you don't give me an explanation today, I'll make sure everyone in Jiang'an City knows that the women at Gilded Club have sticky fingers. Let's see how you do business after this!"

At these words, Xiang Jinsheng's expression shifted drastically. Looking at Ning Qing with an iron-clad, livid face, he demanded:

"Ning Qing, what on earth is going on here?"

Clenching her palms tight, Ning Qing looked up at Xiang Jinsheng.

"Boss Xiang, I never took this thing!"

Xiang Jinsheng said sternly:

"If you didn't take it, how did the guest's property end up inside your bag?"

Ning Qing argued anxiously:

"It really wasn't me! I wouldn't do something like that. I'm afraid some people just can't stomach the sight of me and intentionally framed me!"

As she spoke, her gaze locked onto Ling Xiahe, then flickered to Zhang Yining, who was looking away with shifting eyes.

Hesitating for a moment, Ning Qing asked:

"Yining, you were sitting right on my left at the time. Did you see me touch my bag?"

For a moment, everyone's eyes landed on Zhang Yining, and Ling Xiahe's gaze carried an explicit warning.

Zhang Yining glanced away guiltily from Ning Qing. She indeed hadn't seen her touch it. However, she knew that before Ning Qing walked in, there hadn't been any jade Buddha on the table at all; someone must have slipped it in while cleaning up the spilled wine.

At the time, Ning Qing was busy cleaning up, and the only two people who hadn't pitched in were Ling Xiahe and Lu Xiao.

The culprit was practically screaming her own name. Swallowing her fear, Zhang Yining mustered the courage to say:

"I didn't see Qingqing touch that jade piece!"

An uproar broke out among the crowd, everyone turning to look at Lu Xiao and Ling Xiahe. Ling Xiahe's eyes stared warningly at Zhang Yining.

Ning Qing spoke up again:

"Yining, right before I walked in, did you see any jade Buddha on the table?"

She had seen it, but before Ning Qing entered, the jade Buddha had clearly been in Ling Xiahe's hands, being toyed with!

"I... didn't pay attention!"

Afraid of stirring up trouble, Zhang Yining ultimately held her tongue.

Ning Qing gave her a grateful look, then turned to face the crowd:

"Very well, thank you, Yining! From the time I walked in until the jade Buddha went missing, it was barely a couple of minutes. Whoever pulled this stunt, confess right now!

I promise to let bygones be bygones! But if you insist on framing me, once I uncover the truth, I'll make sure whoever framed me pays dearly!"

With pointed intent, Ning Qing stared right at Ling Xiahe, her direct gaze making the other woman feel somewhat guilty.

Ling Xiahe's eyelashes fluttered slightly, but things had already come this far; she had no retreat left...

Besides, Lin Yamei had already said she would warn Xiang Jinsheng in advance; if he knew what was good for him, he wouldn't keep protecting this Ning Qing!

If she backed down now and offended Lin Yamei... her own ending wouldn't be any better!

With that thought, she put on an indifferent expression and continued pouring fuel on the fire:

"Ning Qing, you're really talking out of your ass more and more these days! You've got motive, you've got evidence right there; what's left to argue about? Boss Xiang, according to the rules, you should know very well how to punish this! Or is our club going to harbor someone with sticky fingers?"

Ling Xiahe shot a vicious glare at Zhang Yining as well.

Right now, making Ning Qing disappear completely was the only way to ensure peace of mind!

And that Zhang Yining couldn't be kept around either!

Xiang Jinsheng's eyes turned dark and unreadable.

Lowering her gaze in thought for a moment, Ning Qing seemed to remember something:

"Ling Xiahe! It was you, wasn't it? Just now, you deliberately bumped into my arm to spill the drink, and in the chaos, you slipped this thing into my bag!"

Ling Xiahe's eyes flickered as she hastily denied it:

"Ning Qing! Stop shifting the blame and spouting nonsense! Everyone saw this item get pulled out of your bag. You claim I dropped this jade Buddha into your bag; well, did anyone actually see me do it?"

Ling Xiahe raised her chin slightly, her eyes brimming with a provocative challenge as she looked at Ning Qing.

And while Zhang Yining hadn't seen it either, she had already pieced most of it together. Yet, remembering Ling Xiahe's warning just moments before, she trembled slightly and didn't dare say another word.

She was no match for this crowd!

chapters.title: Are you trying to drive me away?
chapters.content:
Ning Qing was momentarily speechless. She truly had no evidence, but from Ling Xiahe's smug look, Ning Qing could already tell this was all set up by her!

Arguing now was useless; Ling Xiahe was determined to pin it on her! Despicable!

Lu Xiao sneered, toying with the jade Buddha in his hand, and looked impatiently at Xiang Jinsheng:

"Alright! It's clear enough, Boss Xiang! The item has been found, and the culprit has been caught red-handed! Are you trying to cover for her?"

Xiang Jinsheng's brows knitted tightly, a nameless tangle of emotions rising in his heart.

He glanced sideways at Ning Qing beside him, then shifted his gaze to Lu Xiao, a deep look flashing in his eyes.

This must be that "good show" Lin Yamei had warned him about yesterday.

He could only blame Ning Qing herself for going out of her way to provoke people she couldn't afford to cross!

With this thought, Xiang Jinsheng spoke with a feigned expression of conflict:

"Ning Qing, you know the rules of our club. We cater exclusively to high-end clients, and we absolutely do not tolerate anyone with sticky fingers. Regarding today's matter, regardless of whether you did it or not, the item was found in your bag, so you must take full responsibility... Pack your things and leave immediately."

Ning Qing gasped as she looked at Xiang Jinsheng, finding this sudden outcome hard to believe.

How could he make her leave?

She had thought the worst consequence would be paying some compensation or taking a few slaps to the face as a lesson.

The cruelty of reality far exceeded her imagination.

"Boss Xiang... are you trying to drive me away?"

Xiang Jinsheng partly avoided her gaze, giving her only a look that meant she was on her own, before turning to Lu Xiao and saying:

"Mr. Lu, are you satisfied?"

Lu Xiao gave a light scoff, nodding with a satisfied expression on his face.

"You know what's good for you!"

Ning Qing felt as though she had just jolted awake from a dream. Her gaze slowly swept across the faces of the people in the private room; there was mockery, pity, and above all, contempt.

She couldn't leave; she needed the high salary here, and her mother was still in the hospital... She couldn't afford to lose this job!

Otherwise, it would be equivalent to a death sentence for her mother!

After a moment of thought, she grabbed the sleeve of Xiang Jinsheng's shirt and pleaded bitterly:

"I beg you, don't drive me away! I can apologize, I'll take any punishment, beatings or scoldings, I'll accept them all! Boss Xiang, you know my mother is still in the hospital, I need this job! I really can't leave this place! I'm begging you!"

Ling Xiahe loved watching the drama unfold; the look she directed at Ning Qing was filled with triumph.

"You can't leave this place? Then get down on your knees and beg big brother! Boss Xiang is just enforcing the rules impartially! Acting like this makes it look like you're trying to use moral blackmail!"

Hearing this, Lu Xiao also raised an eyebrow at Ning Qing, biting down on the cigarette butt in the corner of his mouth:

"That's right! Are you going to kneel or not? If you kneel, maybe I'll soften my heart!"

At these words, everyone turned their eyes simultaneously toward Ning Qing.

Suddenly, Xiang Jinsheng said:

"Kneel for what? Even if she kneels, she's still getting kicked out..."

Only to be sharply rebuked by Ling Xiahe:

"Boss Xiang! How would you know unless you try? Who knows, maybe big brother's heart will soften?"

Xiang Jinsheng clenched his teeth. Of course he knew that kneeling or not kneeling wouldn't change the fact that Ning Qing was going to be driven away.

However... by tomorrow, when word got out, people would only say that his Gilded Club didn't protect thieves, and that he drove away a cash cow just for the sake of his reputation.

After weighing his options, he ultimately said nothing more.

Ning Qing's face turned somewhat pale as she glared with bitter hatred at Ling Xiahe.

The next second, she walked over and dropped to her knees.

"Mr. Lu, I beg you! Don't make me leave this place!"

However, what awaited her was only a loud burst of laughter.

Though the woman in front of him was indeed pitiful, still... three million!

Trading a stranger's life for it, totally worth it!

Lu Xiao put away his smile, waved a hand, and said:

"You've finished kneeling, now get the hell out of here!"

"Didn't you say..."

Before Ning Qing could finish her sentence, she was interrupted by Lu Xiao's cold voice.

"I never said I'd let you off just because you knelt! If you want to blame someone, blame yourself for offending someone you shouldn't have!"

"..."

Ning Qing finally saw the reality of the situation. She bit down hard on her lower lip and gave a cold, bitter laugh.

This whole show was put on just to drive her out!

How could she still not understand? From start to finish, this whole thing was targeted at her by Lin Yamei!

Lin Yamei had just finished putting on a fake, hypocritical act of apologizing to her, and immediately afterward, someone came to cause trouble for her! Aside from her, Ning Qing couldn't think of anyone else.

She lowered her eyelids to conceal the blazing fury in her eyes, then turned around to face Ling Xiahe and Lu Xiao in the room.

Everyone else remained silent.

Ning Qing said every word with chilling clarity:

"Today, I fell into your trap, and I will remember this! But you'd better pray there doesn't come a day when you fall into my hands, or else I will make you wish you were dead!"

Lu Xiao and Ling Xiahe didn't bother to argue back, wearing an indifferent expression that seemed to say: "What can you possibly do to us?"

Lu Xiao was especially smug; his task was complete, and next, without the protection of the Gilded Club, he just needed to kill her when she least expected it and collect his three million!

Ning Qing quietly returned to the dormitory and simply packed the few belongings she had.

Then, with absolute resolve, she stepped out through the main gates of the club.

The night breeze brushed past, gently caressing Ning Qing's face, carrying away a sliver of the bitterness in her heart.

Ling Xiahe, Lin Yamei, Xiang Jinsheng; we have a long time ahead of us!

Dragging her suitcase, Ning Qing stood by the roadside, looking blankly at everything around her before randomly choosing a cheap hotel and checking in.

Once inside, Ning Qing took out her phone to check her bank account balance.

The short string of numbers instantly plunged her into deep contemplation, and a bitter smile spilled from the corner of her mouth.

To pay for the exorbitant medical expenses, she had exhausted almost all her savings.

Now, she couldn't even afford a second night at the hotel.

A wave of sorrow washed over her, and she finally couldn't hold back her tears.

For a long time, Ning Qing sat there in a numb, daze of deep thought.

Just then, the ringing of her phone shattered her contemplation.

Looking at the caller ID, she hesitated for a moment before finally pressing the answer button.

"Xue Yi, is something wrong?"

On the other end of the line, Xue Yi's steady voice immediately came through.

"Ning Qing! Are you alright? Why didn't you pick up when I called you just now?"

A call?

Ning Qing flipped through her call log and only then realized that Xue Yi had called her three or four times.

Suppressing the ache in her heart, she forced a natural tone and said:

"I'm fine, I was just busy a moment ago. Did you need something?"

"It's about Auntie's situation at the hospital. I was thinking maybe... no! Ning Qing, did something happen to you? If you were busy, how could it be so quiet?"

Ning Qing paused, evading the question:

"I... I was out buying things."

"Ning Qing, are you still lying to me?"

Ning Qing let out a light sigh, helplessly abandoning her pretense.

"Nothing can be kept from you."

She hesitated for a moment, but ultimately decided to tell Xue Yi everything she had experienced today without holding anything back.

After listening, Xue Yi on the other end of the line fell silent for a moment.

"Ning Qing, it's probably for the best that you quit. We'll figure something out about the money; that place was never meant to be a long-term solution anyway. Where are you staying right now? I'll come find you."

"I'm at a hotel."

"How much money do you have left on you?"

Ning Qing offered a bitter smile, words failing her as she paused. Pausing again, it seemed she truly had no other options left.

"... Just over a hundred."

chapters.title: Today is my birthday
chapters.content:
Xue Yi chuckled:

"So, are you planning to sleep on the street tomorrow? You need money everywhere these days, you might as well come stay at my place!"

Ning Qing knew in her heart that Xue Yi's feelings for her had long gone past mere friendship, but she herself held no romantic feelings for him.

"There's no need! Xue Yi, you've already..."

"Ning Qing! Are you going to turn me down even over a small favor like letting you crash on my couch? Besides, my parents have been nagging me to move back home these past few days anyway, so just take my place!"

Xue Yi's voice was firm and left no room for argument. Ning Qing tightened her grip on the phone. After a brief pause, she gritted her teeth and said:

"Xue Yi, I know how you feel about me. Putting aside the fact that I have nothing and can't promise you anything, I still have a load of vengeance to seek, and my future is completely unknown. I really don't want to..."

Xue Yi smiled faintly, looking at her tenderly as he said:

"Qingqing, I understand everything! We grew up together. If I were in your shoes, would you leave me to fend for myself?"

Xue Yi's words completely blocked off any avenue for Ning Qing to refuse.

Unable to turn him down, Ning Qing ultimately had no choice but to agree.

---

The next day.

Xue Yi rushed to the hotel bright and early to pick Ning Qing up and take her to his apartment. Afterward, he efficiently packed up his own things and headed back to his parents' place.

Before leaving, he handed Ning Qing five thousand yuan.

Ning Qing stood alone in the empty room, her gaze fixed on the money resting on the table. Suddenly, a profound sense of loneliness surged over her like a tide.

At that moment, she wished so, so much that she had a beloved family member by her side; someone she could pour her grief out to, someone she could have a good, hearty cry with.

Even if it were just a shoulder, or an embrace.

Three years felt like a lifetime apart.

Though she put on a strong, resilient front in front of her only friend, Xue Yi, she ultimately couldn't fool herself.

Over the years, she had exhausted every effort, enduring humiliation and surviving in the shadows, all to search for the slightest trace of the person who set that fire. Yet, the truth remained shrouded in thick fog, always blurry and out of reach.

She was so tired...

Especially today, on this special day.

Mom, you must hang in there and get better soon.

Thinking of this, Ning Qing clutched her aching heart and hailed a cab to the hospital.

In the hospital ward, looking through the glass at her unconscious mother, whose body was tangled in various tubes, Ning Qing felt a sharp pang in her heart.

She pressed her palm against the window, crying bitterly as she vented her resentment and hardship.

Tears streamed down in endless strings.

"Mom... I will be strong, I won't give up! You mustn't give up either, okay?"

"Mom, when are you going to wake up? I'm so tired. Please wake up, wake up... Even if it's to force me to practice the piano, or make me study painting... Mom, will you hug me again? Please?"

"I miss Dad so much, I miss my brother so much... I miss Maodou, Xiaobai, Tiaotiao..."

"Living is so hard. I really should have listened to you back then and learned more skills and arts. But I've finally grown up now; I know how to throw darts to protect myself, and I even read those pharmacology books you used to force me to read. Can you hear me?"

"Mom, I'm twenty-three years old today. Today is my birthday. Will you sing me a birthday song?"

...

Her longing strung together like beads, yet it received not the slightest echo.

Through that layer of transparent glass, she could only see a quiet figure surrounded by various tubes and instruments, lying motionlessly as if completely cut off from the world.

Helplessly, Ning Qing pressed herself against the cold glass, tears silently slipping down.

She slowly closed her eyes and slumped exhaustedly against the wall, sliding down to sit on the floor.

In this world, she was entirely alone; all her grief and tears had to be swallowed silently in the dark, known to no one.

---

The next day.

Li Ren arrived at the Gilded Club in a fairly good mood.

He had taken the friendly advice of Jin Shui and Yin Shui to heart, being told that certain women cared about more than just money; they cared about dignity and human touch, too.

Those were things he had indeed neglected in the past, being too used to being direct and straightforward.

This time, he had patiently helped her deal with Lin Yamei; she had saved face and kept her dignity, so how could she possibly have the nerve to turn him down again?

Today, he was going to take this little vixen home with him!

In the private room, the mamasan came over enthusiastically to greet him.

Who would have expected that, after a few questions, Li Ren's expression would turn uglier than if he owed a fortune.

"She left?"

"Yeah! It just happened yesterday. I was wondering myself how she got mixed up in something like this; Ning Qing isn't that kind of person, but as for the details... I stepped out a few times, so I'm not too clear on it. Why don't you ask our Boss Xiang?"

The mamasan replied nervously. This big boss was not someone to be trifled with; she had to be careful not to say the wrong thing!

Upon hearing this news, Li Ren's expression darkened abruptly, his eyes turning as gloomy and overcast as a stormy sky.

"Got it, you can go first."

The mamasan practically fled back to the lounge before daring to take a deep breath.

Li Ren leaned back lazily, resting his index finger lightly against his temple, his brows furrowed in a flicker of puzzlement.

He had intended to take Ning Qing away today, only to find out she was not only missing, but had already been fired.

He had clearly instructed Xiang Jinsheng simply to ensure Ning Qing wasn't approached by any shady characters; was this how he handled things?

The person was completely gone.

Li Ren's intuition told him that things might not be as simple as they seemed.

With this thought, a trace of displeasure surfaced on Li Ren's face as he lifted his gaze and told Jin Shui:

"Bring the boss here."

Receiving the order, Jin Shui promptly hauled Xiang Jinsheng out of his office.

"L-Lord Li!"

Xiang Jinsheng's voice trembled as he managed to squeeze out a few words.

Outside the door, Ling Xiahe perked up her ears, carefully eavesdropping.

Meanwhile, Li Ren remained nonchalant, a dagger dancing nimbly across his knuckle-defined fingers as he spoke without even raising his head:

"What the hell happened with Ning Qing?"

Watching that sharp blade spinning back and forth in Li Ren's palm, Xiang Jinsheng felt as though he were looking at slices of his own flesh being peeled off one by one by that very knife.

Anxiously wiping the sweat from his brow, he dropped heavily to his knees and pleaded eagerly:

"Lord Li! It... it was yesterday when a client ordered Miss Ning to his table, but who would have expected an incident to occur shortly after? The client's jade thumb ring went missing, rumored to be worth hundreds of millions. When they searched, that jade Buddha was found inside Ning Qing's bag. I had no choice; after all, such a matter is disgraceful, and I was forced to dismiss Miss Ning."

Li Ren raised his eyes to cast a sidelong glance at him, a trace of disbelief in his expression.

For some reason, subconsciously, he didn't believe Ning Qing would do such a thing.

"She stole something?"

"Yes, she was caught red-handed, and she couldn't deny it. Lord Li, the client was aggressive, so I had no other choice. She did earn quite a bit of money for our club; if not for this kind of incident, why would I ever fire her?"

As Xiang Jinsheng spoke, his body shook continuously, hoping to gloss the matter over...

Li Ren lowered his long eyelashes, studying Xiang Jinsheng with a critical eye.

"Why?"

Xiang Jinsheng suddenly looked up, hesitating for a moment before stammering:

"Because of her mother... her mother is in the ICU, and the expenses are astronomical... Perhaps she just lost her judgment for a moment."

Li Ren listened without expression.

"Whose was it that she stole?"

"The client's name is Lu Xiao. I've heard of him in the underworld; he's a gambling addict. Yesterday must have been his first time coming here. I checked the surveillance; he arrived in a red sports car, but who dropped him off... I wouldn't know."
